world.title: Ancestral Land
world.introText: Ancestral Pagoda Land is the holy land of Ancient Buddha Clan. The Clan's members went to the holy land to form their pagoda using the Ancestral Power that is available in the Ancestral Pagoda.

world.title: Ancient Haven Palace
world.introText: Combined meaning: “Primeval/Primordial Heavenly Palace” (literally) or “Ancient Heaven Palace”.
world.history:
Ancient Haven Palace was a dominant force during ancient times, ruling the entire Skylaw Continent, filled with powerful experts.  Furthermore, the Palace's founder and leader was one of the Nine Emperors in the ancient times, the Heavenly Emperor.

Ancient Haven Palace was split into five Halls and nine Mansions. The one in the Hunting War was the Fourth Hall Master of the Ancient Haven Palace, who was in charge of Northern region of the Skylaw Continent. The five Hall Masters were all at the very Peak of Perfected Earth Sovereign Stage (Half-step Heavenly Sovereign Stage). Although the nine Mansion Lords were somewhat weaker, they were all existences that had stepped into the Earth Sovereign Stage and were all outstanding elites.

Aside from Earth Sovereign experts, the Palace had three Heavenly Sovereigns. The Heavenly Emperor was in possession of one of 36 Peerless Divine Arts, Three Pures. It’s an extremely marvelous technique. It could split himself into three, forming two other separate clones, and both clones possessed similar strength as the main body. Therefore, the Heavenly Emperor himself was equivalent to three Heavenly Sovereign experts.

Before his fall, the Heavenly Emperor sealed the entire Ancient Haven Palace and concealed it in a hidden spatial realm within the Skylaw Continent. The Starlight Demon Suppression Pyramid can be used to sense the Palace location.

Palace Lord: Heavenly Emperor.

Five Hall Masters, each at Half-step Heavenly Sovereign Stage.

Nine Mansion Lords, each at Earth Sovereign Stage.

world.title: Black Eerie Swamp
world.introText: Black Eerie Swamp is an extremely vicious land within the Northern Spiritual Realm. However, it is quite different than the Northern Spiritual Field. At least in the Northern Spiritual Field, Adventurer Teams would often head there. As for the Black Eerie Swamp, it is almost a forbidden land within the Northern Spiritual Realm.

world.title: Black Poison Marsh
world.introText: Bubbling pools dot the landscape, releasing noxious fumes that erupt in bursts of poisonous gas. Once in a while, viscous waves of black mud cascade. Under the black mud, scarlet and vicious eyes would emerge and slowly sweep around the surroundings

world.title: Deification Pool
world.introText: In the past, the Phoenix Clan came into agreement with the other flying Divine Beasts and flying Supreme Divine Beasts. When the Heavenly Sovereign experts of each clan about to die, they would enter the Deification Pool and melt their bodies and blood essences, and fused into the Pool. This way, their descendants would be able to make use of the bloodline source left by their ancestors to purify their bloodline and evolve.
world.trivia: The Deification Pool was basically similar to the Divinity Sea in the Divine Beast Origin. However, the Pool was easier for absorption, since the Heavenly Sovereigns willingly entered before their deaths. On the other hand, the Divinity Sea came from those experts who died in battle, all of which contained different Wills. Thus, it was more violent and harder to absorb.

world.title: Demonic Python City
world.introText: Formerly, it was under jurisdiction of Nine Nether Palace. After Nine Nether King went missing, Blood Hawk Palace forcefully took over this city.

world.title: Divine Beast Continent
world.introText: Divine Beast Continent was a colossal continent in the Great Thousand World during ancient times. At that time, roughly 70% to 80% of all Spiritual and Divine Beast clans in the Great Thousand World inhabited this continent.
world.history:
Divine Beast Continent was a colossal continent in the Great Thousand World during ancient times. At that time, roughly 70% to 80% of all Spiritual and Divine Beast clans in the Great Thousand World inhabited this continent.

When the Fiend Clans invaded the Great Thousand World, they also attacked the Divine Beast Continent, sparking an unimaginably brutal war. During the onslaught, they forcefully shattered the Divine Beast Origin and used a black hole to swallow it whole.

With this vital region gone, the forces of the Divine Beast Continent were pushed into a steady retreat. During that devastating battle, the Divine Beast Continent shattered and fragmented. Even so, the fragmented continent remaining today are so massive that they are still classified among the super continents of the Great Thousand World.

In ancient times, the Divine Beast Continent was so vast that even a Sovereign powerhouse flying at full speed for decades would struggle to traverse it from end to end.

world.title: Divine Beast Origin
world.introText: During the ancient era, Divine Beast Origin was home to numerous exceptionally powerful Divine Beasts, including quite a few Supreme Divine Beasts. The strength of this single region accounted for roughly thirty percent of the entire Divine Beast Continent’s total combat power.
world.history:
During the ancient era, Divine Beast Origin was home to numerous exceptionally powerful Divine Beasts, including quite a few Supreme Divine Beasts. The strength of this single region accounted for roughly thirty percent of the entire Divine Beast Continent’s total combat power.

During the ancient war, the Fiend Clans took notice of the Divine Beast Origin’s might. They sent dozens of their Monarchs to attack the region, catching the Divine Beast Continent off guard. They forcibly shattered the Divine Beast Origin and used a black hole space to devour it. Only after trapping the Divine Beast Origin in a black hole were they able to push the Divine Beast Continent into a steady retreat, resulting in the fall of countless Divine Beasts.

After the ancient war ended, several top-tier powerhouses managed to sense the Divine Beast Origin trapped within the black hole space. Through combined efforts, they made it reappears, though only once every few years. Taking advantage of this, numerous Spiritual and Divine Beast clans seize the opportunity to enter and seek their fortunes.
world.trivia: The Spiritual Energy in the Divine Beast Origin contains a trace of energy that could refine physical bodies.

world.title: Divine Spiritual City
world.introText: Upon the commencement of the Divine Spiritual Mountain Competition, the atmosphere of the city completely erupted, with countless shadows shooting towards the skies like a swarm of locusts. The enticement of the Divine Spiritual Baptism is too strong, with countless people already having eyes on the baptism.

world.title: Divine Spiritual Mountain
world.introText: The mountain is situated close the the center of the Northern Heavens Continent. The location where the Divine Spiritual Mountain stands is within a fragmented space. There are spatial gales in the surroundings of the Divine Spiritual Mountain. The participants have to avoid being swept by the gales, as the consequence would be certain death.
world.history: Originally, there wasn't anything special about this mountain. However, due to a Heavenly Sovereign expert passed away on the mountain, the originally normal mountain turned into something extraordinary.  The Spiritual Aura here is said to be mixed with the blood and flesh of the Heavenly Sovereign expert who had passed away here, and is extremely beneficial to the refinement of one’s fleshly body. However, the mountain had been sealed-off by a unique and powerful energy left behind by the deceased Heavenly Sovereign expert. The mountain was always in a state of being locked-up in an isolated space, which caused no one could intrude upon it.  This isolation would weaken once every three years, where some cracks would appear that enabled people to enter. But only those below Sovereign Stage could enter the cracks, because there were some pressures which prevented Sovereign-level experts to get close to the mountain.

world.title: Divinity Sea
world.introText: A boundless ocean that looked fresh red, akin to an ocean of blood. But what made it even more startling was the fact that there wasn’t any stench of blood coming from it.  All the blood essences of the fallen Divine Beasts in the God’s Cemetery were gathered here.
world.trivia: The flow of time in the Divinity Sea was much slower than the outside world, roughly four times slower than the outside world. It means that cultivating half a year here would equivalent to two years of cultivation outside.

world.title: Dragon-Phoenix Pool
world.introText: Dragon-Phoenix Pool was formed by bones of the True Dragon and True Phoenix. The bones of the True Dragon and True Phoenix sprinkled all over the Dragon-Phoenix Haven when they fell. Because of that, some bones of the True Dragon and Phoenix would clash together, forming the bizarre Dragon-Phoenix Pool.

world.title: Dragon-Phoenix Stage
world.introText: Dragon-Phoenix Stage is a dazzling and massive stone platform within Dragon-Phoenix Haven that looked to be forged from gold. The upper level of the Dragon-Phoenix Stage was covered in dense layers of clouds, only a vague golden luster could be seen. But the pressure that descended from the sky instantly made countless experts feel suffocating.

world.title: Dragon-Phoenix Stairs
world.introText: Ten golden stairs located at the summit of the Dragon-Phoenix Stage. The Dragon-Phoenix Inheritance was at the end of the stairs. Eligible participants had to ascend those stairs to receive the inheritance. Those ten stairs were hard to ascend as the terrifying dragon and phoenix pressure practically wanted to crush those ascending the stairs into meat paste.

world.title: Earth Sovereign expert’s Treasury
world.introText: The Treasury was the place where Earth Sovereign powerhouses had fallen. In this Treasury, one could find Spiritual Divine Liquids and other precious inheritances of the fallen Earth Sovereign.

world.title: Endless Fire Territory
world.introText: Xiao Yan established the Endless Fire Territory a few hundred years ago, and it had become a supreme force in the Great Thousand World that wasn’t any weaker than those Five Ancient Clans. Only the Martial Ancestor of the Martial Realm and a few others could be comparable to the Flame Emperor.
world.history:
Xiao Yan established the Endless Fire Territory a few hundred years ago, and it had become a supreme force in the Great Thousand World that wasn’t any weaker than those Five Ancient Clans. Only the Martial Ancestor of the Martial Realm and a few others could be comparable to the Flame Emperor.

Many years ago, Flame Emperor became famous after he took Divine Flame from Fire Spirit Clan and defeated the clan's strongest Old Ancestor in the process. After that, he established Endless Fire Territory that built in Burning Mountains. This was a crimson continent with a high temperature. There would occasionally be volcanic eruptions with blazing magma flowing out.

world.title: Escort Platform
world.introText: Each student must touch the Stone Tablet (Manhua: Evaluation Stone) in order to get their respective Rank Symbol.

world.title: Fallen Battlefield
world.introText: The Fallen Battlefield was extremely famous in the Northern Region, since there were many inheritances in it. There were even quite a bit of supreme powerhouse inheritances, thus attracting many people over. But only a few of those that entered the Fallen Battlefield in search of treasures had made it out. That’s because, in the past, there were tens of thousands of powerhouses that fell here, and their deadly intent tainted this place. This kind of stuff is extremely troublesome, since they’re formless. If it’s dense enough, one’s Spiritual Energy might even be corroded and cause a huge drop in fighting strength. Furthermore, the fallen powerhouses causing the Spiritual Energy in the battlefield to be as violent as a volcano and Spiritual Energy storms would occasionally form. It was something that even Earth Sovereign powerhouses would fear.

world.title: Gate of the Northern Heavens
world.introText: It is filled with boundless Spiritual Energy due to a Rank-8 Spirit Convergence Array located right outside of the Gate. Nevertheless, it is a terrifying place that would cause the faces of the people in the Academy to change when mentioned. In the past, there were some outstanding students who had entered it. However, in the end, due to being unable to handle the pressure within that place, they suffered mental damage, resulting in them turning crazy. This accident caused the Academy decided to shut it down.
world.appearance: Its entrance is a massive bronze door approximately a hundred meters tall with mysterious runic patterns on its surface.

world.title: God’s Cemetery
world.introText: In ancient times when the Divine Beast Origin shattered, the powerhouses on this continent had fought against the Fiend Clans and most of them had fallen in the depths of the Myriad Beast Graveyard. When the powerhouses of the Fiend Clans fell, the evil aura from them had attempted to taint the remains of the powerful Divine Beasts. Fortunately, the remnant Wills of those Super Divine Beasts combined together and resided in the depths of the Myriad Beast Graveyard, protecting their remains and suppressing the Monarchs of the Fiend Clans at the same time.

world.title: Great Thousand World
world.introText: The Great Thousand World comprise a vast Upper Plane (upper world) interweaving with countless smaller worlds called as the Lower Planes.
world.appearance: Note: This taxonomy applies only to individual entities, not to organizations or clans.
world.personality:
After the first war against the Fiend Clans (the Ancient War), approximately 49,000 years ago, the Great Thousand World was divided with half of the World occupied by the Fiend Clans. Even many Lower Planes were also occupied by the Fiend Clans. The inhabitants of the occupied areas became the Fiend Clans' livestock. The Fiend Clans slaughtered them whenever they are hungry.

The Fiend Clans are like locusts in their path as they devour the world's Spiritual Energy. Once they invade a continent, the Spiritual Energy completely disappears in that continent causing it no longer a suitable place for cultivation of Spiritual Energy. It becomes ordinary place with the disappearance of Spiritual Energy.

After Mu Chen killed Heavenly Evil Monarch in the second war (the Final War), the remnants of the defeated Fiend Clans are scattered and flee from  the Great Thousand World.
world.trivia:
Continents within the Great Thousand World are categorized by their size into Super Continents and Ordinary Continents. There are ten Super Continents and countless Ordinary Continents. The Hundred Spirit Continent where the Northern Spiritual Realm located, is only considered to be a very tiny continent located in the remote area.

Every continent that reaches a certain size possesses a profound and mysterious power known as the Continent Energy, however, it can only be harnessed by a Heavenly Sovereign.

Continents are separated by vast oceans or formidable natural barriers that would make even a Sovereign shudder in fear. Some continents are entirely isolated by spatial torrents; attempting to traverse them is extremely perilous, even for those at the Sovereign level.

Fortunately, the Great Thousand World is home to formidable Spiritual Array Masters who can construct Teleportation Spiritual Arrays to connect the continents. For example, Qing Yanjing constructs a long-distance Teleportation Spiritual Array connecting the Skylaw Continent with the Hundred Spirit Continent. To achieve this, she only needs the Spatial Coordinates of both sides.

Mu Abode (current ruler).

Ancient Haven Palace (former ruler, destroyed).

Grave Guardians.

The sealed Heavenly Evil Monarch.

(Xiao Yan relocated his Lower Plane from its original location and placed it within this Continent)

The other two Four Great God Clans.

Northern Spiritual Alliance (current ruler).

Hundred Spirit King (former ruler).

Many famous Auction Houses.

Celestial Fox Sect.

world.title: Greatlaw Blaze Pond
world.introText: It is a huge volcano located in the mountain peak within vast black mountain range. The volcano filled with blazing magma, linked to a Spiritual Energy Fire Source deep down. So there are vast amounts of Spiritual Energy mixed in the magma. The magma is fused with Spiritual Energy, possessing the effect of refining meridians. Furthermore, there are lots of Spiritual Fire Pythons and other inhabitants inside the volcano which have great benefit for cultivation.

world.title: Greatlaw Goldpond
world.introText: Greatlaw Goldpond is a place within Great Heavenlaw Domain with appearance of vast golden lake. It is used for refining the Sovereign Celestial Body and could make the body gets stronger.

world.title: Greatlaw Peak
world.introText: On the Greatlaw Peak, stands a towering palace that emits an ancient aura, as if it is left behind from the ancient times. It causes revere to rise in the heart of people.

world.title: Greatlaw Sky
world.introText: It serves as the headquarters of the Great Havenlaw Domain. After Great Havenlaw Domain merged into Mu Abode, it is used as the headquarters of Mu Abode.

world.title: Heavenly Emperor Cemetery
world.introText: The Heavenly Emperor Cemetery was built by the Heavenly Emperor himself, a realm.

world.title: Heavenly Lake
world.introText: It was a place inside the Ancient Haven Palace for refining one’s body and Spiritual Energy. The baptism of the Heavenly Lake could transform one’s physical body and refine the Spiritual Energy at the same time. It could also nurture the Sovereign Celestial Body, causing it to gain a promotion from the baptism.

world.title: Hidden Scripture Pavilion
world.introText: Hidden Scripture Pavilion was the place where the Ancient Haven Palace deposited variety of powerful Divine Arts and Divine Abilities.

world.title: Hidden Spiritual Courtyard
world.introText: Mu Chen obtains Spiritual Condensing Bowl in this place.

world.title: Hundred Battles City
world.introText: Hundred Battles City is the biggest and most important city of the Hundred Battles Domain. It is managed by the three main forces (Myriad Swords Valley, Demonic Corpse Sect and Great Compassion Sky).

world.title: Hundred Battles Domain
world.introText: The various forces in the Hundred Battles Domain were headed by those three forces. Because of the territories of Hundred Battles Domain and Great Havenlaw Domain being connected together, the Hundred Battles Domain had been endlessly nibbling away territories from the Great Havenlaw Domain. Although the Great Havenlaw Domain would fight back, the Great Havenlaw Domain had also exercised restraints due to that mysterious Domain Ruler of theirs who had always been in seclusion. So, in recent years, the Hundred Battles Domain had been getting more and more arrogant, especially since they had the support of the Sky Profound Palace, they vaguely did not place the Great Havenlaw Domain in their eyes.

world.title: Lesser West Heaven Realm
world.introText: Combined meaning: “Little/Lesser West Heaven Realm”.

world.title: Lightning Territory
world.introText: Anyone who reaches Spirit Stage strength can enter that place by paying 500 Spiritual Value Points. Aside from cultivation, one could condense the divine lightning into a Divine Lightning Bead. This is quite popular within the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy. It is worth 200 Spiritual Value Points per bead in the Spiritual Value Hall.

world.title: Liu Territory
world.introText: After offending many forces and losing Liu Jingshan as their backbone, half of the Liu Territory's lands are divided among the other eight territories. Also, the Liu Territory has to pay various compensations, which make their family become bankrupt. To add insult to injury, all their experts decide to say goodbye to them.
world.history: After offending many forces and losing Liu Jingshan as their backbone, half of the Liu Territory's lands are divided among the other eight territories. Also, the Liu Territory has to pay various compensations, which make their family become bankrupt. To add insult to injury, all their experts decide to say goodbye to them.

world.title: Lower Planes
world.introText: Lower Planes are independent worlds that interweave with the Upper Plane of the Great Thousand World. The Great Thousand World is the center of those numerous planes.

world.title: Luo God City
world.introText: Combined meaning: “City of the Luo Goddess” or “Luo God City”.

world.title: Luo River
world.introText: When Luo Shen died, she turned into an enormous river, known as the Luo River. The Luo God Clan protects it as it is rumored to possess the inheritance of Luo Shen’s Luo God Celestial Body, one of the greatest Sovereign Celestial Bodies.
world.history: When Luo Shen died, she turned into an enormous river, known as the Luo River. The Luo God Clan protects it as it is rumored to possess the inheritance of Luo Shen’s Luo God Celestial Body, one of the greatest Sovereign Celestial Bodies.

world.title: Merchant City
world.introText: In this city, Mu Chen and Jiu You encountered Lin Jing while vying for the Void Great Solar Fruit and Undying Divine Leaf.
world.history: In this city, Mu Chen and Jiu You encountered Lin Jing while vying for the Void Great Solar Fruit and Undying Divine Leaf.
world.trivia: Ling Qingzhu makes her first appearance in this city.

world.title: Merchant Continent
world.introText: Merchant Continent, as its name suggests, is a hub of trades. Although this continent is not vast in size, it hosts numerous well-known auction houses and enjoys a resounding reputation across the Great Thousand World. Its fame stems from the countless treasures gathered from all corners, circulating through major auctions. Hence the saying: With enough Sovereign Spiritual Liquids, you can buy anything.
world.appearance:
Merchant Continent, as its name suggests, is a hub of trades. Although this continent is not vast in size, it hosts numerous well-known auction houses and enjoys a resounding reputation across the Great Thousand World. Its fame stems from the countless treasures gathered from all corners, circulating through major auctions. Hence the saying: With enough Sovereign Spiritual Liquids, you can buy anything.

The continent is densely packed with forces of all sizes, and most of the auctions held here have powerful backers. Despite the abundance of treasures, few dare act recklessly.

A few hundred years ago, a prominent figure from a dominant force tried to seize a treasure after failing to win it at auction. He killed both the auction manager and his rival, then fled with the treasure. The Merchant Continent responded swiftly. In just a few dozen days, the force behind that prominent figure was surrounded by all sorts of powerful forces. His faction was besieged, he was gravely wounded, and ultimately forced to return the treasure and paid a considerable price to settle the matter. Since then, no one dared to ignore the rules of the Merchant Continent anymore: Do not kill others in the auction to seize treasures.
world.trivia: This continent has a Teleportation Spiritual Array directly linked to the Skylaw Continent.

world.title: Mission Hall
world.introText: This Hall is in charge of distributing all sorts of missions to the Academy’s students. Those who could complete these missions would receive rewards. The missions are differentiated into three ranks, with the Heaven Rank mission as the highest rank. This kind of mission not only required strength but also sufficient experience.

world.title: Myriad Beast Graveyard
world.introText: There were a few Super Divine Beasts that fell in the Myriad Beast Graveyard. Super Divine Beasts were pinnacles amongst the Divine Beast Clans, comparable to Heavenly Sovereigns.

world.title: Nine Dragon City
world.introText: Nine Dragon City is the second strongest underworld force within the Northern Spiritual Realm, after Mang Yin Mountain.

world.title: Nine Heavenly Steps
world.introText: However, if one wanted to stand on the Nine Heavenly Steps, one would need to possess absolute strength, since there would be countless people with bloodshot eyes battling out like mad men for the opportunity to stand there. If one’s strength wasn’t sufficient, there would only be one ending! Being killed and sent away from the Nine Heavenly Steps!

world.title: Nine Nether Continent
world.introText: Although its size is only comparable to the Northern Region of the Skylaw Continent, the continent is well known due to the Nine Netherbird Clan as its overlord.

world.title: Nine Nether Realm
world.introText: Nine Nether Realm was originally a plane that was independent of the Great Thousand World.  It was later managed to be linked to the Great Thousand World by the almighty powerhouse of the Nine Netherbird Clan and became the Ancestral Ground of the Nine Netherbird Clan. Presently, Nine Nether Realm was located in the Nine Nether Continent of Great Thousand World.
world.history: Nine Nether Realm was originally a plane that was independent of the Great Thousand World.  It was later managed to be linked to the Great Thousand World by the almighty powerhouse of the Nine Netherbird Clan and became the Ancestral Ground of the Nine Netherbird Clan. Presently, Nine Nether Realm was located in the Nine Nether Continent of Great Thousand World.

world.title: Nine Territory City
world.introText: The Nine Territories of the Northern Spiritual Realm usually hold their meetings in this city (Nine Territories Meeting).

world.title: North Desolate Grave
world.introText: The Immortal Body of the Immortal Emperor rests at the very bottom of it, after going down 9900 steps below the chains that bound the Heavenly Evil Monarch.

world.title: Northern Domain Plains
world.introText: Northern Domain Plains is the location where the Northern Domain Assembly takes place. The plains is located in the southwest of the Northern Domain of Skylaw Continent, at the intersection of the three major powers: Violet Cloud Sect, Thunder Note Mountain, and Golden Eagle Mansion.

world.title: Northern Heavens Continent
world.introText: Formerly, the continent was close to being ruled by the Demonic Dragon Palace, but White Dragon Sovereign stole one of their precious treasures, which weakened them significantly, causing them to be at a disadvantage against the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy. They Demonic Dragon Palace has forever been resentful of this and have tried to reacquire the treasure while entering a protracted war against the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy.

world.title: Northern Heavens Hall
world.introText: This Hall would only appear if any of the newly joint students had reached the highest rank, Rank 9 Symbol.

world.title: Northern Heavens World
world.introText: Northern Heavens World is a place in which Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy conducts entrance examination for its newly joint students.  It is a vast, endless landscape with blue skies and drifting clouds, and boundless ancient forest. Also, home to great numbers of Spiritual Beasts. There are numerous powerful and vicious Spiritual Beasts all over the place.

world.title: Northern Spiritual City
world.introText: This is why none of the disputes within the Northern Spiritual Realm would spread over here. Thus, the Northern Spiritual City is a bustling location. It is comparable to the cities in the Nine Territories.

world.title: Northern Spiritual Field
world.introText: Because the Northern Spiritual Field is rich in resources, even Mu Chen’s father personally leads his men into it from time to time.  Every time they enter, they are bound to have many tragic battles.

world.title: Northern Spiritual Realm
world.introText: In the Northern Spiritual Realm, there are many other forces aside from the Nine Territories which could considered as independent forces. Their strengths are below the Nine Territories, but few of these independent forces have quite remarkable strengths which are not too far apart from the Nine Territories, such as:

world.title: Oceanic Mountain Continent
world.introText: As the name implies, this Continent is covered by mountains and oceans with a million-foot high mountain that stretches endlessly.

world.title: Pagoda City
world.introText: Pagoda City was located at the heart of Pagoda Continent.  Ancient Buddha Clan's headquarter was resided in the city.

world.title: Pagoda Continent
world.introText: The Ancient Buddha Clan dominated the entire continent. By naming the entire continent  as “Pagoda”, one could tell that the Ancient Buddha Clan treated the entire continent as their own territory, they were the ruler of the continent.

world.title: Primordial Immortal City
world.introText: This City was constructed by the Immortal Emperor. Primordial Immortal Pagoda, the place where Primordial Immortal Assembly is held, located in the center of the City.

world.title: Primordial Sacred Abyss
world.introText: Primordial Sacred Abyss, located in the depth of Sacred Abyss Continent, was an ancient battlefield between the Great Thousand World and the Fiend Clans.

world.title: Punishment Hall
world.introText: The majority of the Punishment Hall members were students of the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy that had already graduated, but chose to stay behind. With each successive batch, they provided a unceasing supply of fresh blood into the Punishment Hall.

world.title: Sacred Abyss City
world.introText: When Mu Chen went for exploring the Primordial Sacred Abyss, he first came to this City.

world.title: Sacred Abyss Continent
world.introText: Actually, it is not a true continent, but rather an evolved Lower Plane that has linked with the Great Thousand World to form an independent spatial realm (独特空间, Dútè Kōngjiān).
world.history:
During the ancient era, the Sacred Abyss Continent served as one of the primary battlegrounds between the Great Thousand World natives and the invading Fiend Clans. The cataclysmic conflict claimed the lives of countless powerhouses, including more than ten Heavenly Sovereigns.

In the wake of this devastating warfare, innumerable Divine Abilities, inheritances, and even Saint Artifacts were lost across the broken realm. Over the ensuing millennia, many fortunate individuals have chanced upon these extraordinary legacies, instantly rising from obscurity to renown. Driven by these legendary success stories, a continuous influx of powerful cultivators from the Great Thousand World flocks to the continent, each hoping to become the next lucky one.

world.title: Skylaw City
world.introText: It had never been controlled by any particular force, but co-managed by all the supreme forces of the Skylaw Continent.

world.title: Skylaw Continent
world.introText: As one of the famed major continents of the Great Thousand World, the wideness and flourishes of this continent far surpassed Mu Chen’s expectations. Forces are as innumerable as stars, embellishing in this area.  Because of being too complicated, there was not a true Overlord in this major continent as no forces managed to achieve that. Not even a Heavenly Sovereign expert could unite the entire Skylaw Continent.

world.title: Spiritual Arts Room
world.introText: There are three floors in the Spiritual Arts Room. The first floor provides the lower ranks Common Tier Spiritual Arts. The second floor provides Higher ranks Common Tier plus six Low-Rank Spiritual Tier. While the third floor provides the most powerful Spiritual Arts within the Academy, all ranked at Spiritual Tier.

world.title: Spiritual Jade Island
world.introText: Ling Xi is imprisoned in this island for three years.

world.title: Spiritual Light Mountain
world.introText: It is a towering and magnificent mountain, approximately 33,000 meters tall, rises into the sky, reaching the clouds. At its peak, clouds and mist swirl around, making it difficult to see the scenery there.
world.appearance: It is a towering and magnificent mountain, approximately 33,000 meters tall, rises into the sky, reaching the clouds. At its peak, clouds and mist swirl around, making it difficult to see the scenery there.

world.title: Spiritual Light Realm
world.introText: It is a bizarre world that seemed like the primal chaos. Abundant Spiritual Energy fluctuates in this primal chaotic world.  Because of the Spiritual Energy being too massive, spiritual clouds floating in the sky can be seen everywhere. However, this Realm lacks life energy, so it is unable to host life on a long term basis. Within the realm, a lot of Spiritual Spawns are drifting around, emitting majestic Spiritual Energy.

world.title: Spiritual Road
world.introText: The Spiritual Road is formed from a fragment of a plane. Within that peculiar place, no one is able to use any energy. In other words, within the Spiritual Road, whether it be the Spiritual Energy, Dou Qi, Yuan Li, or any type of energies, none of them can be utilized.
world.appearance:
The Spiritual Road is formed from a fragment of a plane. Within that peculiar place, no one is able to use any energy. In other words, within the Spiritual Road, whether it be the Spiritual Energy, Dou Qi, Yuan Li, or any type of energies, none of them can be utilized.

The participants who enter the Spiritual Road will face all manner of life-or-death perils and brutal trials. Unable to draw upon spiritual energy, they can only rely on their raw physical bodies, their sharp instincts, and their wits to survive the dangers. This method of driving people to the brink of death is indeed an effective way to temper one's will.

When entering the Spiritual Road, the participants are told that if they want more power, then they must have an unshakable resolve. Only by controlling this resolve, will they be able to become someone truly strong.

In the ten million years, 70-80% of the strongest powerhouses that came out of the Five Great Academies had participated in the Spiritual Road’s trial. Thus, you can see how important the Spiritual Road’s trial is. This is also why many geniuses would go after it like ducks.

Every three years, the Spiritual Road would be opened. In this event, members of the younger generation from all over the Great Thousand World have their cultivation temporarily sealed and compete by fighting for the Spiritual Crown. People tend to die every day during this event.

The entry selection for the Spiritual Road was quite strange. It was not selected through human means, but it was searched out by a Divine Artifact known as the Mirror of Judgement. The people that were selected by this Divine Artifact were mostly people with excellent talents.

The participants who could successfully pass through the trial in the Spiritual Road would obtain the qualifications to join one of the Five Great Academies, Also, they would obtain Spiritual Energy Empowerment from the Spiritual Road.
world.trivia:
In the entire Northern Spiritual Realm, Mu Chen was the only one who obtained the qualification to participate in the Spiritual Road. However, he was expelled after just one year because of the bloodbath he caused in the Spiritual Road. Therefore, he was called “The Blood Calamity”.

Mu Chen's first meeting with Luo Li was in the Spiritual Road.

Luo Li chased Mu Chen for over half a year in the Spiritual Road in order to kill him.

Mu Chen obtained the mysterious black paper (Sealing Volume of Immortal Catalog) in the Spiritual Road.

characters.introText: Luo Li is the main female protagonist of The Great Ruler and the Empress of the Luo God Clan.
characters.appearance: She usually wears a black dress, embroidered gold thread skirt which gives her a noble look. Elegant and beautiful porcelain face. Silvery white hairs enhance the beauty. Radiant white skin. Most eye-catching exquisite cheeks and rosy lips. Pair of pure glassy eyes. Swan-like, graceful and slender neck, under which is the delicate sexy clavicle and the full curvature of the front of the chest. Delicate slender waist. The perfect proportions make people wonder about the wonders of the Creator. Slim porcelain legs further add to the perfection.
characters.personality: Her personality is indifferent. She always maintains a cold attitude to everyone. But only before Mu Chen, she would show all the colors of emotions.
characters.history:
She meets Mu Chen in the Spiritual Road while she was being attacked by others, where Mu Chen saves her life. Due to this incident she starts to grow some feelings for Mu Chen. These feelings seem to her like a weakness and in order to get rid of these feelings, she tries to kill Mu Chen. Mu Chen promises to her that if she can catch him within half an year he will willingly die at her hand. After running after Mu Chen for half an year at the last moment she catches Mu Chen and draws her sword to kill him, but finds out that she cannot bring herself to kill him. In that half an year of time while running after him, she had already fallen in love with Mu Chen. She would later reveal that Mu Chen's fearless attitude and confidence when facing his enemies has given her the courage to face her own trials.

Later, Mu Chen was forced to leave the Spiritual Road due to an incident planned by Ji Xuan, and she promises Mu Chen that she will wait for him in the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy. To take revenge for Mu Chen and stop Ji Xuan from taking the Spiritual Crown at the end of Spiritual Road she fights against Ji Xuan, which leads to both of them being severely injured. She tells Ji Xuan that she won't kill him because one day Mu Chen will come to take his life.

Later, She joins Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy where she meets Mu Chen again. There she becomes the leader of the Luo Goddess Association which was actually made for her by her followers. She always follows Mu Chen though her actual strength is higher than him.

In the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament she follows Mu Chen, and due to his exceptional leadership skills their team scores most points in the initial stage of the competition and they reach the finals of the knock out round. Their team's popularity surpasses Ji Xuan, Wen Qingxuan and other talented youngsters from other Academies. While Mu Chen was trapped and couldn't join the final round in time, she used her full power for the first time, unsealing the Lou Shen Sword and fought against the Blood God Clan's young leader, Xue Tianhe.

After the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament, her grandfather, Luo Tianshen, traveled to the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy to take her back to the Luo God Clan, where she began to accept the Luo God Clan's inheritance. She led the Luo God Clan fighters to battle against the Blood God Clan, and during the battles, she gradually gained the approval of the Luo God clansmen. Later, she became the Empress of the Luo God Clan after completing the Luo God Ceremony. During the ceremony, she was able to summon the spirit of the ancestor, first beauty in the world, Luo Shen, and successfully inherited the legacy of Luo Shen while Mu Chen was protecting her from the Blood God Clan. She also became the owner of the Luo God Celestial Body.

After Mu Chen obtains a Seed of the Continent quota with the help of the Xiao Yan, she goes to participate in the competition. She wins in the Lesser Earth Sovereign Battlefield and becomes one of the "Seed of the Continent". Together with Mu Chen, they gain 70% of the baptismal power and shared 40% with Mu Chen, accepting 30% for herself. After the Baptism she’s a Peak Lesser Earth Sovereign.

She agrees to become the Holy Maiden of The Ancient Spirit Clan, only after learning that Celestial Chi Yan wanted to take her into the Primordial Sacred Abyss to try and recover their clan’s long-lost Divine Ability, Ancient Spirit Channelling Light, one of the 36 Peerless Divine Abilities, and that the Ancient Buddha Clan would also be sending their own younger generation to find their own long-lost Divine Ability which decides if they can become the Patriarch of the clan.

When Mu Chen inherited the Immortal Body in the Ancient Maha Clan's Ancient tower, he was being attacked by the Ancient Maha Clan, as it was their family treasure for thousands of years. At that moment, Luo Li appeared there to support Mu Chen. Even if she was only at the Spirit Level Heavenly Sovereign Stage Late Phase, with the sacred artifact of the Ancient Spirit Clan in her hand, she was fearless.

During the final war against the Fiend Clans, in the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy, she fought against Black Corpse Sky Monarch but eventually lost, and was saved by Mu Chen.

After the final battle was over, Mu Chen and Luo Li held a grand marriage under the witness of Mu Feng, Qing Yanjing, Luo Tian Shen, Flame Emperor Xiao Yan, Martial Ancestor Lin Dong and others. Later, she gave birth to a daughter named Mu Yunxi.

Luo Li has a crush on Mu Chen nearly immediately after they met. She attempts to kill him to quash those feelings as she says she only needs to focus on Cultivation instead of feelings.

She is poisoned by Xue Tu nearly immediately after she leaves the Spiritual Road, as he was attacking a city controlled by the Luo God Clan and she came as a back up. An undetermined elder sacrifices his life to allow her to escape through a teleportation device that looks like a portal.

When she makes it through, her grandfather tells her that because she's been poisoned she can't receive the inheritance of the Luo God Clan, and so she has to find the Nine Netherbird and use the bloodline of the Undying Bird to cleanse her body.
characters.trivia:
Her hair is originally black, but it turns silver due to the Gong Fa Spiritual Art she cultivates. However, when she summons the Luo River's Spirit, her hair reverts to its original black.

She is able to manifest the Luo God Flower during the Luo God Ceremony, something possible only for those with the purest royal bloodline.

Besides Luo Shen, she is the only person to successfully cultivate the Luo God Celestial Body.

She receives the Heavenly Spirit Jade Essence as a gift from Mu Chen.

"I don’t want to have a good opinion of you. I only wanted to focus on my training. If I have a favorable opinion of you, I will be distracted." - Luo Li to Mu Chen, when Mu Chen asked why she wanted to kill him.

characters.appearance:

His gentle and radiant smile enhances his striking charm, while his distinctive elegance sets him apart from others.

Mu Chen has a great resemblance to his mother.

characters.personality:
Resilient and Determined
With iron will and determination, Mu Chen faces every challenge head-on, no matter how difficult the journey becomes. His resilience is highlighted by his ability to grow stronger through failure - a trait noted by Wen Ling, who praised his capacity to learn from setbacks. After being expelled from the Spiritual Road and losing a year of cultivation along with the more important Spiritual Energy Empowerment, Mu Chen set aside regret and trained diligently to catch up. His strong-willed personality enabled him to overcome this significant setback.

Calm and Confident
Mu Chen is known for his unwavering calmness and self-confidence. He maintains composure in all situations, never allowing arrogance to cloud his judgment, even as his power grows. This trait stems from his acute awareness of his own capabilities and limitations, as well as his humility. This composure is evident in his battles, where his disposition rivals that of seasoned veterans who have fought hundreds of battles. When arranging Spiritual Arrays, he remains utterly composed, shutting out all distractions and negative emotions. Even when facing stronger opponents, he shows no trace of fear or panic, allowing him to act with precision and focus. Mu Chen once created two different Spiritual Arrays in quick succession while facing powerful spiritual beasts, showcasing his ability to remain focused and precise.

Unflappable under any circumstances.

Humble and self-aware.

Emotionally disciplined, avoiding impulsive decisions.

Strategic and Composed Under Pressure
Mu Chen’s strategic brilliance and mental resilience are most evident in high-stakes combat. His sharp analytical mind allows him to dissect opponents’ weaknesses and exploit them with precision.

Kills Xue Tu with a Borrowed Knife

Example: In the "Kill with a Borrowed Knife" tactic, he manipulated the Silver-Horned Panther Dragon to defeat Xue Tu, turning a powerful foe’s strength against them. Even when overwhelmed, he remains composed, shutting out fear and doubt to execute complex plans flawlessly. He meticulously calculates all the steps in order to send Xue Tu to death.

Interpersonal Values - Respectful, Compassionate, and Protective
Mu Chen deeply values relationships and demonstrates unwavering respect, compassion, and loyalty in his interactions with others. He shows immense respect for his elders and mentors, genuine care for his juniors, and protective toward his friends and family. While he avoids unnecessary conflict, he does not hesitate to act decisively if someone threatens those he cares about, even risking his life to ensure their safety. Whether defending his allies or risking his life for family, Mu Chen demonstrates unmatched dedication and courage.

Example: Wen Ling, a subordinate of Mu Chen’s father, is impressed by his respectful and humble learning attitude, despite his exceptional talent in Spiritual Arrays and his status as the Mu Territory’s young lord.

characters.quotes:
"Don’t worry dad, I will help you complete what you have failed at. If you believe in me, then I will let our family reunite with each other one day, nobody will be able to stop it!" Mu Chen to Mu Feng.

"If mother was that powerful, why did she fancy dad?” Mu Chen grinned as he muttered under his breath.

“Since Sister Qian’Er thinks so highly of me. I will sacrifice my life and accompany you. Don’t worry, Sister Qian’Er. Even if I have to risk my puny life, I will definitely help you obtain the Accumulation Elixir.” Mu Chen to Tang Qian'er.

"Are you trying to raise a dog?" Mu Chen to Luo Li.

“To those individuals that come to trouble me, I don’t know how to be merciful to them. If you enjoy that, you can come at me by yourself. But if you allow those dogs of yours to come over again, I do not mind teaching them a lesson.”  Mu Chen to Liu Mubai.

"Whether it is mule or a horse, you’ll know soon." Mu Chen to Mu Feng.

"You don’t necessarily have to rely on your fists to get rid of them. There’s something calling seizing the opportunity. It’s something I enjoy doing the most. In the Spiritual Road, it saved me many times." Mu Chen to Mu Feng.

“So you took advantage of her when she was in a perilous state. When mother had her strength sealed, it must be when she had her guard down the most. Otherwise, why would she fancy you, dad?” Mu Chen to Mu Feng.

"Although all of the people here are quite powerful, there’s no need to be afraid. If you lack courage, how could you compete with others?" Mu Chen to Mo Ling, as he knew that Mo Ling had a bit of an inferiority complex.

"Sun’Er. I’ll leave these three fellows (“Steel Rhinos”) to the two of you. If you can’t resolve this situation, we will have to temporarily cancel tonight’s dinner.” Mu Chen to Ye Sun'er as he tried to encourage Sun’er in order to improve her courage/mentality.

"Ge Hai, right? Although this place isn’t the Spiritual Road, to be honest, in the past you were never qualified to be my opponent. Even now, you still aren’t." Mu Chen to Ge Hai.

"The number of people I killed on the Spirit Road alone is more than the total you’ve killed between all of you."  Mu Chen to the Demonic Dragon Guards.

“Senior, you’re highly respected and worshipped in the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy. Playing a joke like this on a girl isn’t something suitable.” Mu Chen to Northern Sea Dragon.

"Relax. As long as you're beside me, regardless of any danger, even if we die, I'll die before you." Mu Chen to Luo Li.

"Thank you, but I really can’t endure any longer." Mu Chen to Luo Li as he pushed her down.👏

"You are the one that did not say anything. Furthermore, I am not interested in your figure." Mu Chen retorts indignantly to Mandala’s threat after she abruptly stripped off her dress to leap into a pond.

“There is no absolute fairness in the world. One can only charge bravely through the path of a supreme powerhouse. If one doesn’t have enough ability and loses the opportunity, they can only blame themselves.” Mu Chen to Luo Li.

characters.history:
He was born beyond the Great Thousand World as the son of the Sacred God. He fled from his homeland after his father's death. The fleeing Heavenly Evil Monarch then began a conquest of the newly discovered Great Thousand World in ancient times with his Fiend Clans (known as the Sacred Race in Dragon Prince Yuan (DPY) novel). He was the first alien lifeform to set foot in the Great Thousand World.

During the ancient war between his Fiend Clans against the natives of the Great Thousand World, nearly half of the Great Thousand World territories fell under Fiend Clans control. The war only ended when the Immortal Emperor (the then strongest in the Great Thousand World and the first person reaching the Ruler Stage) sacrificed his life to seal the Heavenly Evil Monarch within the North Desolate Grave. The seal lasted for 49,000 years until present times.
characters.trivia:
During ancient times, he was powerful enough to kill the Immortal Emperor, but due to World Suppression, he was only able to fight with him to a standstill.

His Cultivation Realm is dictated by how many eyes he can open at a time.

The Heavenly Evil Monarch used a secret technique allowing him to open the tenth eye, completely overwhelming the trio Lin Dong, Xiao Yan, and Mu Chen.

In chapter 1837 of the Absolute Resonance novel, he left behind a Resurrection Seed in the Divine Continent World, serving as a contingency. If he failed and perished in the Great Thousand World, it would allow him to revive himself from within the Divine Continent World.

characters.introText: Nine Netherbird (九幽雀, Jiǔ Yōu Què) a.k.a. Jiu You is one of the main characters of "The Great Ruler". Her father is the Patriarch of Nine Netherbird Clan.
characters.appearance: When Jiu You evolves into Divine Beast (Nine Netherworld Bird), she attains the ability to take human form. Her human figure is described as graceful with pair of jade legs were slender and slim, Smooth and stretch taut. On top of her jade legs, she is supporting a waist and ample chest, and on top of that, there is a snow-white neck that is similar to a swan’s. Her rosy lips lightly lifted, showing her charming faint purple eyes. She is extremely sexy and filled with wildness that could make a man’s heart arouses.
characters.personality: In the beginning, she was chilly, full of wildness and carefree. But later, she is full of a mysterious sense of charm, but also because of her possession of a pure Primordial Undying Bird bloodline, she is not easy to approach.
characters.history:
For an unknown reason, she came nearby the hometown of Mu Chen, Northern Spiritual Realm. She failed during the evolution, in the Black Eerie Swamp. Later entered into the body of Mu Chen and tried to kill him. But she was suppressed by the mysterious black paper in the body of Mu Chen. When Mu Chen went to the Northern Heavens World, he obtained 2 high ranked beast blood essence and was targeted by others. Jiu You attempted to swallow the blood essences, but it was too strong for her, she was forced to form Bloodline Bond with Mu Chen as last resort. From then on, Mu Chen was able to use some of her power as his own. Bloodline Bond is a higher form of utilizing beast blood essence rather than simply swallowing it up, because it allows the beast to keep their intelligence and prevent the power from waning away with time, but it is rarely seen on human because of proud nature of high ranked beast. It also has the downside that if one died before another, it will cause the other party severe injuries, even death.

Mu Chen bought Northern Sea Dragon's Blood Essence to help her to evolve into Nine Netherworld Bird. After the evolution, she was in deep slumber and when she woke up she had successfully evolved into Nine Netherworld Bird. In the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament, together with Mu Chen, she defeated Ji Xuan showing the supreme strength of terror.

Later, she reclaimed her king position of the Nine Nether Palace of Great Havenlaw Domain. After spending some time in the domain, Mu Chen and Nine Nether participate in the Hunting War where their strength increases towards 5th and 6th level Sovereign. After winning the battle against the Divine Palace and taking over half their territories, Nine Nether receives a message from her clan saying they’d be bringing her back to it. Knowing that this would expose the Bloodline Bond she has with Mu Chen she urges him to disappear and run away, the elder in charge of bringing her back ,Tianque, tells him that while it’s not impossible to overlook the matter of the bloodlink it will be very hard. The condition was for Mu Chen to enter the Divine Beast Origin and help Nine Nether obtain the blood of the Undying Bird so as to cleanse her bloodline from the impurities stemming from the link. The elder does not urge Mu Chen for an answer but does tell him that if he has the courage, to come to the Nine Netherbird Clan and fight for a quota to enter the Divine Beast Origin. After Mu Chen obtains his quota, in Divine Beast Origin Mu Chen and Nine Nether go to the God’s Cemetery located in the Myriad Beast Graveyard . There Mu Chen senses that his Phoenix Tattoo is buzzing with familiarity and fear, recognizing this as a sign of the Undying Bird presence they head in to try and find the Inheritance left behind. After defeating Bai Ming with Mu Chen’s first execution of a Divine Ability Self-Sacrificial Demonic Punch (that he’d obtained earlier in the Divine Beast Origin). Mu Chen and the rest head off for the Platform with the Undying Bird statue. The statue opens its eyes and sends a wave of highest grade Undying Flames, seeing this Nine Nether uses her own blood to protect Mu Chen from the burning of the crystallized Undying Flames. Mu Chen uses the weakening of the flames to his advantage and decides to absorb them into his sovereign ocean. Seeing that Mu Chen had passed its trial, the statue opens its beak and released a palm-sized crimson gem, it’s inheritance blood essence.  After refining the blood and with the guidance provided by the Undying Bird Sovereign Nine Nether breaks through to the 9th Sovereign Realm, which allows her to have the title of Emperor in the Great Heavenlaw Domain. She and Mu Chen return to the Domain to vie for the inheritance of the Ancient Haven Palace that Mu Chen needs.

Nine Nether chooses to fight Oldman Ku, after a small fight she uses her newly learnt art, The Undying Fire Cloak to win her seat as Emperor. 
Nine Nether and Mu Chen head to the location of the Ancient Haven Palace  in the depths of Extreme West in the Skylaw Continent. Together with Lin Jing they trick a prince into a debt of 100,000,000 Sovereign Liquid drops after a fight.  While exploring the Haven Palace, she obtains the Lesser Divine Ability called Wind Summoning Art . Later when she achieved minor success in cultivating it she learns that the Divine Ability stems directly from one of the the 36 Peerless Divine Abilities the Greater Wind Summoning Art. Even though it is classified as Lesser, it still increased Nine Nether’s speed until she could fool Mu Chen’s sight and he believes she could be as fast as an Earthly Sovereign with her cultivation of Ninth Sovereign. 
While in the Haven Palace she obtains a Greater Baptism of the Heavenly Lake  by gathering 99 Spirits of the Heavenly Lake together with Lin Jing and Xiao Xiao.  With it she ascends to the Perfected Ninth Grade Sovereign Realm, just a small step away from the Earthly Sovereign. The baptism also caused her physique to rise to another level. Finally she is left behind when Mu Chen goes to save Luo Li as her cultivation wasn’t enough to be of help.

After Mu Chen became a Lesser Earth Sovereign and went to save Luo Li. Nine Nether felt inadequate as her strength could no longer keep up with Mu Chen so she left Mu Abode and went back to her clan to seek evolution into the Undying Bird. After pestering her father for an opportunity, he decided to take her to the Phoenix Clan to claim their quota of the Deification Pool. Unfortunately the son of the current Patriarch of the Phoenix Clan, Huang Xuanzhi practices the Divine Ability Nine Circulation Saint Art, one of the 36 Peerless Divine Abilities and he needs to devour the bloodline of a Divine Beast in order to make a breakthrough in his cultivation of it into the 9th Nirvana which would allow him to breakthrough into Saint Heavenly Sovereign. Therefore when Huang Xuanzhi sees Nine Nether’s Undying Bird bloodline, he chooses her as the sacrifice needed as the Undying Bird and the Phoenix are closely related. Because Nine Nether truly needs the opportunity presented by the Deification Pool she can’t just leave, and the Phoenix Clan wouldn’t allow it either after seeing her bloodline. Thankfully the quota allows for a protector, and the Nine Nether Clan, calls upon its only Heavenly Sovereign, a Late Phase Spirit Heavenly Sovereign, but it is not enough as Huang Xuanzhi is a true Immortal Heavenly Sovereign. Knowing they were in a difficult position they sent Elder Tian Que to bring word to Mu Chen.

When the day of the opening of the Deification Pool came, Huang Xuanzhi made his move and attacked immediately defeating the Nine Netherbird elder and when Xuanzhi was about to kill him, Mu Chen arrives in time to save both the elder and Nine Nether. After asserting dominance and a brief exchange of words, both Mu Chen and Nine Nether enter the pool to seek opportunities.

While inside the pool, Mu Chen helps Nine Nether gather as many Peak Blood Essences as he can, in order to help her evolve. After Mu Chen defeats someone, Kong Ling'er, Lin Cang and Xiao Tian offer a collaboration deal to Mu Chen as they needed his help to fight Huang Xuanzhi and vie for a Quasi-Saint Peak Blood Essence, he agrees as he needs the essences for Nine Nether. As a team, they succeeded in luring Huang Xuanzhi into a trap sealing array and obtained the Blood Essence, according to their previous deal Mu Chen and Nine Nether took 40% while they took 20% each for a total of 60%. They parted ways and Kong Ling’er revealed her plan to Lin Cang and Xiao Tan, which was to play Oriole to the mantis and cicada Mu Chen and Huang Xuanzhi. Unbeknownst to her, Huang Xuanzhi wasn’t trapped in the array, just a 50% strength clone, and he confiscated their share of the Blood Essence for himself. Feeling confident about his chances of beating Mu Chen, he goes to find him to seize the remaining share and Nine Nether’s Booodline. After a difficult fight where Mu Chen had to use both of his Peerless Divine Abilities, he defeated Huang Xuanzhi and obtained his 60% Blood Essence, which Mu Chen decides to use to further evolve his Dragon-Phoenix Physique, while leaving Nine Nether with the remaining 40%.

After leaving the Phoenix Clan, Mu a Chen and Nine Nether return to the  Nine Netherbird Clan to undergo closed door cultivation and focus on breaking through, after 2 months of refinement, Nine Nether successfully evolves into the Undying Bird after her Lightning Tribulation was successfully passed. Her true body now has the appearance of a Black Phoenix. With her evolution complete she steps into the Late Phase Spirit Heavenly Sovereign Realm.

characters.history:
Upon learning that Luo Li has joined the Academy, Li Xuantong immediately goes to meet her. However, after noticing her close relationship with Mu Chen, he warns Mu Chen that remaining by her side is a grave hindrance to her. He demands that the couple break up, a proposal Mu Chen flatly rejects. Despite Li Xuantong's attempts to come between them, Mu Chen does not harbor any ill will toward him.

To prove that Mu Chen will not become a burden to Luo Li, Li Xuantong challenges him to a Pact of Three Moves. When they finally face off, Mu Chen successfully withstands the first two moves. He then shocks the spectators by launching his own counteroffensive on the third move, managing to injure Li Xuantong and secure a strategic victory.

After defeated in the Pact of Three Moves, Li Xuantong informs Mu Chen of the immense burdens Luo Li must face in the future, providing crucial background on the Luo God Clan and the severe impact of her father's death.

Later, as they enter the Spiritual Light Realm for the Academy's Hunting War, he tells Mu Chen that their three-move pact is void if they cross paths again. Although they do not meet immediately, they eventually end up teaming up to take down the three Great Generals of the Punishment Hall, who serve as the final challenge of the Hunting War.

Following their success in the Hunting War, Li Xuantong accepts that his love for Luo Li is unrequited. He joins the first-ranked student on the Heavenly Rankings, Shen Cangsheng, in his pursuit of Mo Longzi. However, Mo Longzi orchestrates a trap, leaving both of them heavily poisoned. Though they manage to send a distress signal, they are left in critical condition. Ultimately, Mu Chen arrives as part of the rescue squad, locates them, and cures their poison. They confront Mo Longzi, who challenges them to a final showdown at the gates of the West Desolated City.

During the consecutive five-battle confrontation, Li Xuantong takes on Gui Xiong. Putting his life on the line to snatch victory, he stabs Gui Xiong in the throat. He then moves to assist Mu Chen against Mo Longzi, stalling the enemy while Mu Chen prepares his final trump card. He watches as Mu Chen decisively wins and mercilessly attempts to execute Mo Longzi, who is only saved at the last second by the Black Dragon Sovereign. Witnessing Mu Chen's extraordinary feats, Li Xuantong finally acknowledges that Mu Chen has surpassed him and truly possesses the right to walk side-by-side with Luo Li.

When Shen Cangsheng is chosen as a team leader for the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament, he is assigned on his team, along with Su Xuan, He Yao and Yang Lin.

characters.trivia:
He and Flame Emperor respect each other very much due to their efforts in resisting the invasions of the Fiend Clans. They both established their territorial foundations on the very borders of the Great Thousand World to face them.

Lin Dong became acquainted with Mu Chen when he appeared to fight a Heavenly Demon Emperor alongside Xiao Yan, to protect their children, Xiao Xiao and Lin Jing. Like Xiao Yan, he is also fond of Mu Chen and gave Mu Chen a talisman that allows him to be summoned at will. This talisman would later indirectly help Mu Chen as he confronted Battle Emperor to save Luo Li and her clan.

He hates the Battle Emperor for coveting his wife Ying Huanhuan whom he met and tried to take into his harem. As a result, Lin Dong chased the Battle Emperor throughout the Great Thousand World for a month and whenever the Battle Emperor heard of Lin Dong's name, he would flee. When the Battle Emperor got stronger, he established a foundation in the Western Continent, which was far from the Martial Realm's jurisdiction.

He helped Mu Chen to deal with the demon clan reinforcements that occupied White Dragon Sovereign's lower plane who burnt a hole that would allow a Demon to descend into it. The Black Corpse Sky Monarch sent an avatar down to kill Mu Chen, who had the scent of his dead child.

Although unconfirmed, Lin Dong became a Heavenly Sovereign equivalent by absorbing powers of a lower planes Dimensional Fetus and becoming it's Planar Lord back in his home world. After Mu Chen had also become a Planar Lord and breaking through to the Heavenly Sovereign realm, Lin Dong told him some of the characteristics of it and his duties as one.

In the Great Thousand World, the true peak existences were not regular Heavenly Sovereigns but instead, Saint Level Late Phase Heavenly Sovereigns. Near the end of the novel, Lin Dong and Xiao Yan cultivation level had already surpassed the very peak of Heavenly Sovereign, easily surpassing all the other Saint Level Late Phase Heavenly Sovereign cultivators. As they explain it takes much accumulation to sense the Firmament Board.

Lin Dong linked his Lower Plane to the Great Thousand World, and placed the Lower Plane in the Martial Realm.

Later on, they met again in the auction house. Mu Chen would help her to get away from Liu Ming, young master of Sky Profound Palace. He would also help her to get Heavenly Flame Jade Chalcedony she needed for her Sovereign Celestial Body, and she gave him a protective artifact, Defensive Spiritual Jade, to thank him. She would later join Mu Chen to fight against Liu Ming and his people as they tried to steal Mu Chen's Void Great Solar Fruit he won from the auction, which was actually a trap as Mu Chen intend to obtain Liu Ming's Undying Divine Leaf. When Mu Chen seemingly was able to suppress Liu Ming, Demonic Human Elder of Sky Profound Palace appear and tried to kill both Lin Jing and Mu Chen in revenge. However, before he could do so, Lin Jing's mother, Ling Qingzhu, appeared and suppressed him instead together with the group from Sky Profound Palace. When Qingzhu made clear that she must go home, Lin Jing invited Mu Chen to Martial Realm to come along with her, but he rejected as he thought he cannot truly grow his strength if he had such a powerful faction protecting him. Lin Jing was not very pleased by Mu Chen's rejection, but had to accepted Mu Chen's decision while quietly scolded his decision making.

characters.history:
In preparation for the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament, Mu Chen was sent to her for Spiritual Array training by Tai Cang. Upon reaching her, after much begging by Ye Sun'er, Ling Xi eventually gave Mu Chen a chance. After successfully passing her test, she took Mu Chen on as a disciple, attempting to teach him to open his Heart's Eye. However, as her patience wore thin, she eventually let him into the Spiritual Array House, where he almost lost his life, displaying his Great Pagoda Art in the process. This startled Ling Xi, who happened to cultivate similar Spiritual Art, which was the pair of Mu Chen's. This discovery would improve their relationship, as Ling Xi would later regain some of her lost memory on her connection to Qing Yanjing, Mu Chen's mother. She would later help Mu Chen in his cultivation as well as improving his Spiritual Array capabilities.

After their initial separation in the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy, she's not heard of again until Long Xiang goes looking for Mu Chen to both try to capture and warn him about Ling Xi's predicament.
In the end, she was fine and well, learning from a remnant left behind by Qing Yanjing that allowed her to study up to the Heaven level of Scholar rank, with some insights into Ancestor Realm. She travels together with Mu Chen until he goes searching for Heavenly Sovereign opportunities.
characters.trivia:
She is around 2-3 years older than Mu Chen.

Initially, she strongly opposed Mu Chen's Bloodline Bond with Jiu You, fearing that her Nine Netherbird Clan would not tolerate it and will forcefully break the bond, harming Mu Chen in process. But Mu Chen rejected her proposal to undo the bond in a harmless way, citing that as long as Jiu You didn't not wish for it, he wouldn't sever the bond.

The Luo River's Spirit is the most mysterious type of existence in the Spiritual Beast Record, since it wasn’t born through a bloodline, but a mysterious type of existence that used the Luo River as the mother’s body. In the primordial times of the Great Thousand World, there was a mysterious river known as the Luo River, being extremely ancient and the power contained within it was endless and profound.

The Luo River's Spirit required a harsh condition to be born. Not only did it require the Luo River to act as a mother’s body, but it also required someone to be perfectly compatible with it to fuse with when it was still in the infant stage within the mother’s body. Otherwise, the instant a Luo River’s Spirit was born, it would disappear into nothingness and fade away into the Luo River.

The Luo River’s Spirit possesses the ability to evolve. Although it wasn't bound by bloodlines, it was extremely dreadful when it evolved, the Luo River’s Spirit would become the Luo River’s God. The strength it possessed could only be rivaled by those Supreme Divine Beasts that had been cultivating for countless years.

This was especially the case since Luo Tianshen had been injured during confrontations against the other God Clans, leaving his cultivation restrained and in danger of passing away at any time.

This is also why they were reluctant to let Luo Li go to the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy, for fear that Luo Tianshen would pass away before Luo Li could receive the clan's inheritance, leaving the clan without a figure who could repel other forces' invasion. characters.history:
Mandala main body is a Primordial Mandala Flower. She was plucked and nurtured by the Heavenly Emperor. Her main body cultivation level was at the Perfected Earth Sovereign.

During the ancient war, the Fiend Clans devastated the Ancient Haven Palace, leaving Mandala and her comrade Lu Heng as the sole survivors. However, in a moment of vulnerability, Lu Heng betrayed her by launching a sudden attack and placing a deadly curse upon her.  Mandala sealed away her main body and split off a fragment of herself into a budding clone (a weaker vessel) to escape. The clone successfully fled, and later established the Great Havenlaw Domain.

For 49,000 years, Mandala’s clone remains hidden in the Great Havenlaw Domain, evading Lu Heng’s pursuit. The clone, distinct from her main body, possesses different characteristics, making her untraceable.

Mu Chen first encounters Mandala when he ventures into the depth of Greatlaw Goldpond. His presence stirs her from dormancy, especially when she detects the Mandala Flower runes hidden within the Immortal Page inside his body. Seeing an opportunity, Mandala asks Mu Chen to use the runes to suppress the lingering curse within her. This marks the beginning of their mutually beneficial relationship. In return for his aid, Mandala guides Mu Chen in his cultivation. Over time, Mu Chen becomes her most trusted subordinate in the Great Havenlaw Domain.

During Ancient Haven Palace Exploration, Mu Chen helps her to retrieve her main body, restoring her cultivation to Perfected Earth Sovereign. She continues to support Mu Chen and later make him the leader of the newly established Mu Abode which is the continuation of the Great Havenlaw Domain. She becomes the Acting Ruler of Mu Abode, taking care of it in Mu Chen’s stead, as his travels often keep him away.

Later, alongside Mu Chen and other Mu Abode Earth Sovereigns, she embarks on a mission to the Luo God Clan, aiding Mu Chen in his quest to rescue Luo Li and her clan from peril.

After Mu Chen defeats the Greatlaw/Skylaw Alliance leaders he obtains a corpse of a Primordial Mandala Flower with strength at Immortal Heavenly Sovereign Realm.  He gives it to Mandala who then able to break through into the Heavenly Sovereign Stage.  After her breakthrough, her appearance changes from that of a little girl into one of a young lady.  Mandala explains that, “My Mandala Clan originally had a long growing period, to begin with.  So I passes the childhood phase after my breakthrough.”
characters.trivia:
She established the Great Havenlaw Domain to create a safe haven for treating her injuries inflicted by Lu Heng.

She introduces herself to Mu Chen as "Mandala", the name of the flower that is, in fact, her true form.

She recognizes the Great Solar Undying Body and informs Mu Chen that its rank is approximately 30th among the Sovereign Celestial Bodies.

She is also able to tell that Mu Chen is related to Ancient Buddha Clan after seeing his Great Pagoda Art. She warns him that revealing his connection to the Ancient Buddha Clan prematurely would draw fatal attention, prompting Mu Chen to refrain from using the technique until he grows stronger.

He appears as a bald old man clad in a tattered black robe, clutching a crutch in his arms. Thin as a matchstick and with muddy eyes, he seems only a breath away from stepping into his coffin.

In his beast form, he is depicted as a massive jet‑black creature whose body resembles a fish covered in scales, yet with the claws and tail of a dragon. He has wings which rise like towering clouds, stretching outward as though they engulf half the surrounding space.
characters.personality:
He encounters Mu Chen when the latter breaks through to the eighth level of Lightning Territory and attempts to refine Divine Lightning Beads with Jiu You. Initially, he stops them from refining the beads, however upon noticing that they have a Bloodline Bond, offering them a test. Mu Chen accepts the test to take a hit from him and successfully endures it. As a result, the old man provides Mu Chen and Jiu You with a gift each, and then lets them to continue refining the beads.

After the Academy's Hunting War, when he asks Mu Chen to help him getting the Lightning God Pill, it is revealed that he is actually the Northern Sea Dragon. In order to convince Mu Chen, he gives Mu Chen the full version of the Lightning God Physique and teaches him the Divine Black Lightning Poison Finger, as well as helping him with his Spiritual Light Empowerment.

During the Final War against the Fiend Clans, the Northern Heavens Continent is inevitably caught in the enemy's assault. Seven Profound Monarchs (each possessing power comparable to the Immortal Heavenly Sovereign Stage) launch a devastating attack on the Academy. Northern Sea Dragon, who is only at the Spirit Heavenly Sovereign Stage, is gravely wounded by a single strike. Determined to buy time for the students to flee, he decides to self-destruct and drag his enemies down with him. Fortunately, Luo Li, Xiao Xiao, and Lin Jing who are on patrol duty, arrive to rescue him.

When the Martial Ancestor had just entered the Great Thousand World, Wu Liang attempted to seize the Martial Ancestor's beautiful wives. However, he was nearly smashed to death by a single slap. He fled for an entire year, not daring to return home.

This incident had always been a thorn in his heart. He became a gargantuan laughing stock, his fame and reputation plummeting, a perpetual embarrassment.
All those years, he trained frantically, leading to a drastic increase in his strength, dreaming of exacting revenge. Yet he never imagined that as his power grew, the Martial Ancestor would rapidly scale the cultivation realms, rising from a nobody to a peak expert in the Great Thousand World. Faced with such a terrifying existence, Wu Liang lived all those years in fear and trepidation, terrified that the Martial Realm would send experts to eliminate him.

characters.introText: Qing Yanjing is Mu Chen's mother and the current Grand Elder of the Ancient Buddha Clan.
characters.appearance: A white-robed beautiful lady with warm and gentle complexion.
characters.history:
Back then, she lost her way and arrived at the Hundred Spirit Continent, severely injured and practically crippled. At that time, she was at the Perfected Earth Sovereign Stage, and the leaking spiritual energy from her body attracted all spiritual beasts in the forest. She was then saved and fell in love with Mu Feng, then gave birth to Mu Chen. However, as her clan was very strict in regard to bloodline and power, she was deemed as a traitor for birthing a child with impure bloodline. In order to protect her son and her husband, she returned to her clan and allowed herself to be imprisoned by the Grand Elder—Futu Xuan.

She was the Saintess of the Ancient Buddha Clan. In the later part of the novel, she replaces Futu Xuan as the Grand Elder of Ancient Buddha Clan after gaining recognition from the Ancestral Pagoda—the Clan's Saint Artifact.

During Mu Chen's trip to the Ancient Maha Clan to compete for the Primordial Immortal Body, Futu Xuan requests Mu Chen to become the Ancient Buddha Clan Patriarch if he is successful in acquiring the Primordial Immortal Body. In exchange, he will protect Mu Chen since both Futu Xian and Qing Yanjing know that the Ancient Maha Clan would try to impede Mu Chen if he obtains the Immortal Body.
characters.trivia:
In the past, the Ancient Buddha Clan sought a marriage alliance with the Ancient Maha Clan through Maha Tian. However, Qing Yanjing was stubborn and called off the wedding, which was extremely humiliating for the Ancient Maha Clan.

She left behind the Great Pagoda Art for Mu Chen, but left a message to Mu Feng that if Mu Chen does not personally choose it then let the Art gathers dust.
characters.quotes:
"Since you’ve bullied my son, I’ll bully you. What’s the matter?" — Qing Yanjing to Black Dragon Sovereign.

"However, the girl that Mu Chen had kidnapped was actually the little princess of the Luo God Clan, huh? Your eyes are truly good," — said Qing Yanjing with a grin, causing Luo Li’s face to turn beet-red, while Mu Chen gives a dry cough in response.

"Mu Chen’s eyes are better than his dad’s." — Qing Yanjing praises Luo Li’s stunning appearance.

"Mu Chen, since you’ve decided to walk this path, Mom will support you with all my heart. Mom will wait here for the moment where your name will move the entire Great Thousand Worlds!" — Qing Yanjing murmurs.

"Futu Xuan, you were never suitable to be the Grand Elder. Look at your time as the Grand Elder. The Patriarch position has been empty without an inheritor. The Xuan and Mo Bloodlines are holding all the resources in the clan, and not caring for the other talented clansmen, causing the Ancient Buddha Clan to be the weakest of the Five Ancient Clans. All of this is due to your stubbornness!" — Qing Yanjing to Futu Xuan.

“That lass is pretty good, why don’t you take her in as my Daughter-in-Law as well?” Qing Yanjing teases Mu Chen to marry Tang Qian'er.
