characters.history:
Wen Qingxuan is a student of the Myriad Phoenix Spiritual Academy and champion of the Spiritual Road. During the Spiritual Road, she was in two minds as to whether she should have a showdown with Ji Xuan or go for the Spirit Crown, but as she was hesitating, Luo Li prevented Ji Xuan's advancement, giving Wen Qingxuan a clear path to the Spirit Crown. She never forgot this in her heart and subsequently, developed an infatuation with Luo Li. In the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament, she sought out Mu Chen and Luo Li in an attempt to pull Luo Li to her side, but ended up settling with cooperating with Mu Chen's team in a bid to get the treasures from the Divine Wood Mountain. Her alliance with Mu Chen turned out to be quite profitable, with her coming away from the Divine Wood Academy of the Divine Wood Palace fragment with the Green Wooden Vine Robe. However, upon parting with Mu Chen and attempting to regain her points, she fell into an array laid by Xiao Huang, who would then use her as a hostage to try and get the Spiritual Condensing Bowl from Mu Chen. After Mu Chen naturally came to save her, she returned the favour by providing support for him as he broke Xiao Huang's array, and then suppressed Xiao Huang and Xiao Wang, along with Luo Li, while Mu Chen extorted 20,000 points from the Alliance, before handing them to Wen Qingxuan to put her back into second place.

Mu Chen and her meet again in the Sacred Abyss City in the Sacred Abyss Continent where she was revealed to come from the Northern Domain's Wen Clan. They teamed up to help Wen Qingxuan obtain the inheritance of the Spirit-Pellet Butterfly Fairy, which she later obtained with Mu Chen's help.
characters.trivia:
Wen Qingxuan is titled as the Spirit Crown (champion) in the Spiritual Road.

She said that she knows Xiao Xiao, Xiao Yan's daughter, but the two never got to interact with each other throughout the story.

She has mysophobia and thus avoids close contact with others, especially the opposite sex.

She seems to have a slight aversion to the opposite gender, so it's rare for her to befriend someone of the opposite gender.
characters.quotes:
"Captain Mu Chen, I’ll give all of these points to you. Furthermore, I’ll guarantee your admission into the final match. However, the condition is that you allow Luo Li to join my group. What do you say?" Wen Qingxuan to Mu Chen, offering her team points in exchange for Luo Li.

"He was indeed, firm and decisive." Wen Qingxuan praises Mu Chen's decisiveness in battle.

"Mu Chen, if we ever meet again, I hope not to see you depressed. Regardless of anything, you are the Champion of the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament. Although the Five Great Academies are puny in comparison to the Great Thousand World, if you lose your drive and self confidence, I believe I will be very disappointed in you. Also, Luo Li will also be disappointed." Wen Qingxuan to Mu Chen before their parting at the end of the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament.

"Perhaps a Greater Earth Sovereign isn’t anything much in your eyes, but our talents are truly weaker than him, not to mention comparing to those Young Masters of the Ancient Buddha Clan… According to what I know, he doesn’t have any forces to support him, nor does he have any envious resources. He has fought for everything by himself."  Wen Qingxuan, explaining her evaluation of Mu Chen, to Matron He.

characters.history: On her first day in the Spiritual Road, while she was bathing in a river, Mu Chen stumbled across her. Embarrassed, she threw her clothes on and chased him for an entire day, managing to injure him twice in the process. Eventually he retaliated and then stripped her off before throwing her into the river naked. Since then, she's vowed to kill him on sight, screaming exactly that when she saw him during the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament. However, while on the Divine Wood Palace fragment of the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament vying for treasures, Wang Zhong (III) attempted to pull her over to his side against Mu Chen. Rather than join hands with Wang Zhong, she actually decided to help Mu Chen by raising the troublesome point of how they would divide the treasure. This meant that many of the other parties wouldn't join with Wang Zhong, who had joined with Xue Tiandu and Mo Yu, which kept the pressure upon Mu Chen's group to a minimum. After the battle was finished, Mu Chen attempted to make a deal with her, however she wouldn't hear it until Luo Li spoke up on his behalf, at which point she heard him out. Mu Chen offered her ten drops of Sovereign Spiritual Liquid in return for her Divine Wood Plaque, a deal which she rejected, but she handed over the Divine Wood Plaque anyway, saying that he now owed her a favor. Afterwards, she left to partake in the competition of points in the final round of the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament.

characters.history:
She is considered to be incredibly beautiful, with Mu Chen acknowledging that her beauty doesn't lose out to Luo Li's. For her age, she possesses a youthful appearance, and there is a suggestion that there is a link between this and the fact that she likes to nap, sometimes napping for years at a time. Thus, when she met Mu Chen for the first time, she didn't appear to be much older than him. She is among the strongest of the younger generation and is always accompanied by Xiao Cai, a Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python. Together, they have fought several battles alongside Mu Chen as they explored dungeons together, also helping him with his cultivation, most notably helping him in earning his True Dragon Phoenix Body.

After she met Mu Chen, Cai Xiao had decided to go to the Dragon Phoenix Haven so she could obtain the blood essences of a True Dragon. Then Xiao Cai could undergo a complete evolution and have no need to go into a deep slumber.

Myriad Viper Sovereign tried to capture Cai Xiao, she then crushed a scarlet jade plaque with a clench of her fist. When the jade plaque was destroyed, blazing flames poured out and enveloped Cai Xiao’s figure. The flames around Cai Xiao were extremely abnormal. They weren’t a monotone colour, but brightly coloured and seemed to contain more than one fire attribute in that flame. Like flames that flowed like water, the colours were extremely pure. But within that pureness, there was the emmitence of terrifying undulations that could practically destroy anything. “I thought you wanted to capture me.” Cai Xiao looked at the Myriad Viper Sovereign with a mocking smile as she gently lifted her hand. The gorgeous flames flew back and gathered above her, forming into a fire image that looked like a cauldron with a person on it. That person had his hands behind his back with his black hair fluttering in the wind. Behind him, there was a black ruler. Although that figure was only an image, it was as if even the heavens and earth were beneath his feet. Cai Xiao then revealed she is the daughter of Flame Emperor Xiao Yan.
characters.trivia:
She first Introduced herself to Mu Chen as Cai Xiao, using her mother's surname instead of her father's, to conceal her identity as young miss of Endless Fire Territory.

After each nap, her strength would greatly soar. The last time she took a year nap and stepped into realm of Heavenly Sovereign.

Although the seven-colored heaven swallowing python is not a beast of Great Thousand World, once it evolved, it would not lose out to Divine Beast of the world

Xiao Xiao almost always fights with Xiao Cai on her side, and always looks for means to get stronger.

Every time Xiao Cai's strength levels up, Xiao Xiao subsequently gets stronger.

Yao Chen was her teacher in BTTH. Later on, the two would travel together to Ancient Buddha Clan, where they would eventually help Mu Chen together with Lin Jing and Lin Diao of Martial Realm.

"Yeah, a hateful father that always likes to appear at the crucial moment. I’ll surely complain about him when I get back!"- Xiao Xiao complains about Xiao Yan.

"I know why my father has great hopes for you. It’s because you’re like him, you’re both monsters." - Said to Mu Chen regarding his cultivation progress.

characters.personality:
Xiao Yan came to Great Thousand World for the mysterious disappearance of Origin Qi from his lower plane. His fame in the Great Thousand World rose after he took the Divine Flame from the Fire Spirit Clan and defeated the clan's Strongest Ancestor in the process. He also established the Endless Fire Territory which later became one of the superpowers of the Great Thousand World, known for its top quality alchemy products.

When the Xiao Yan first broke through the shackles of the Lower Plane and entered the Great Thousand World, he landed in the Luo God Clan’s territory by coincidence. Luo Tianshen met Xiao Yan and helped him successfully convert his Spiritual Energy. However, Xiao Yan didn’t stay in the Luo God Clan for long. He left right after he recovered. It’s said that he went to search for his two wives Cai Lin and Xun'er.

Ten years later, Xiao Yan had proclaimed himself the Flame Emperor, fought with the Fire Spirit Clan’s Old Ancestor, and had stepped into the Heavenly Sovereign cultivation stage. It was an earth-shaking battle, and torrential flames had turned the entire abandoned continent into a wasteland. The Fire Spirit Clan’s Old Ancestor couldn’t even harm the Flame Emperor after exerting all his methods. In the end, he was forced to admit defeat with his hands cupped. Xiao Yan then asked for a flame from the clan, then left carefree and easy. From that day on, the name of the Flame Emperor was widespread throughout the Great Thousand World.

After that, Xiao Yan founded the Endless Fire Territory. Experts rushed over like ducks lining up. Not only is the Flame Emperor in control of all the flames between heaven and earth, Xiao Yan's skill in refining elixirs is also unparalleled. Thus, the Endless Fire Territory transformed into a colossal existence in only a few decades.

When Luo Tianshen's fell, the entire Luo God Clan was close to death. On Luo Tianshen’s birthday, Xiao Yan sent someone to express his good wishes. The gesture shocked the other three God Clans, who were like tigers staring down their prey. Perhaps none of them expected the Luo God Clan to have such an ally. characters.history:
Xiao Yan came to Great Thousand World for the mysterious disappearance of Origin Qi from his lower plane. His fame in the Great Thousand World rose after he took the Divine Flame from the Fire Spirit Clan and defeated the clan's Strongest Ancestor in the process. He also established the Endless Fire Territory which later became one of the superpowers of the Great Thousand World, known for its top quality alchemy products.

When the Xiao Yan first broke through the shackles of the Lower Plane and entered the Great Thousand World, he landed in the Luo God Clan’s territory by coincidence. Luo Tianshen met Xiao Yan and helped him successfully convert his Spiritual Energy. However, Xiao Yan didn’t stay in the Luo God Clan for long. He left right after he recovered. It’s said that he went to search for his two wives Cai Lin and Xun'er.

Ten years later, Xiao Yan had proclaimed himself the Flame Emperor, fought with the Fire Spirit Clan’s Old Ancestor, and had stepped into the Heavenly Sovereign cultivation stage. It was an earth-shaking battle, and torrential flames had turned the entire abandoned continent into a wasteland. The Fire Spirit Clan’s Old Ancestor couldn’t even harm the Flame Emperor after exerting all his methods. In the end, he was forced to admit defeat with his hands cupped. Xiao Yan then asked for a flame from the clan, then left carefree and easy. From that day on, the name of the Flame Emperor was widespread throughout the Great Thousand World.

After that, Xiao Yan founded the Endless Fire Territory. Experts rushed over like ducks lining up. Not only is the Flame Emperor in control of all the flames between heaven and earth, Xiao Yan's skill in refining elixirs is also unparalleled. Thus, the Endless Fire Territory transformed into a colossal existence in only a few decades.

characters.trivia:
He is the main protagonist of "Battle Through the Heavens".

He met Luo Tianshen, clan leader of the Luo Clan at the time when he came from lower plane and was helped by the latter to convert Dou Qi into Spiritual Energy. When Mu Chen summoned him to help save Luo Li, he healed Luo Tianshen and returned Luo Tianshen's strength to the peak of Upper Grade Earthly Sovereign.

He and Martial Ancestor greatly respect each other and have a good relationship. They both established their territorial foundations on the Northern and Southern borders of the Great Thousand World.

Xiao Yan became acquainted with Mu Chen when he appeared to fight a Heavenly Demon Emperor alongside Lin Dong, to protect their children, Xiao Xiao and Lin Jing. He gave Mu Chen a lantern that allowed the latter to summon him for assistance.

Mu Chen summoned him during his confrontation with the Battle Emperor, who tried to force Luo Li to become his concubine. Shortly after, he bribed the Battle Emperor to allow Mu Chen and Luo Li to benefit from his dungeon event known as the "Child of the Continents." It was a contention that increased a cultivator's foundation or chance to break through the Heavenly Sovereign threshold.

In the Great Thousand World, the true peak existences were not Heavenly Sovereigns but the Saint Level Late Phase Heavenly Sovereigns. Near the end of the novel, Lin Dong and Xiao Yan cultivation level has already surpassed the very peak of Heavenly Sovereign, easily surpassing all the other Saint Level Late Phase Heavenly Sovereign cultivators.

As a Dou Di in his lower plane and Master of all twenty-two Heavenly Flames with him being the first flame, he combines the Heavenly Flames with the Divine Flame he had taken from the Fire Spirit Clan to create his own set of unique flames. It was called the "Emperor Flames" that belongs solely to him.

Xiao Yan linked his Lower Plane to the Great Thousand World, and placed the Lower Plane in the Endless Fire Territory.

Xiao Yan and his Endless Fire Territory is one of the Top Three Pill Refiners within the entire Great Thousand World.

In the final war against the Heavenly Evil Monarch and his Fiend Clans, Ling Qingzhu laughs at Ying Huanhuan for igniting her reincarnation during the final battle in the lower planes. She no longer needs to sacrifice herself this time around to save Lin Dong as he has surpassed the legends of the Great Thousand World.

cultivation.title: Aura Sea
cultivation.introText: Aura Sea (气海, Qì Hǎi) is the reservoir within the body where Spiritual Energy is stored and refined. It is the defining mark of all cultivators below the Sovereign Stage.

cultivation.title: Battle Formation Master

infobox.Similarities: Both must resonate with and control external power beyond their own body: Array Masters harness the world’s Spiritual Energy, while Battle Formation Masters harness a troop’s collective Battle Wills.
infobox.Differences: Power Source: The world’s Spiritual Energy.

cultivation.introText: A Battle Formation Master has the ability to gather the strength of an army/troop, unleashing the extreme boundary of the army power. A high-level Battle Formation Master with a powerful army can contend with a Heavenly Sovereign expert.
cultivation.appearance:
A Battle Formation Master has the ability to gather the strength of an army/troop, unleashing the extreme boundary of the army power. A high-level Battle Formation Master with a powerful army can contend with a Heavenly Sovereign expert.

An ordinary commander can only bring out 10-20% of their troop's Battle Wills at best. But with better comprehension regarding control over Battle Wills, a Battle Formation Master is able to bring out much higher power of Battle Wills.
cultivation.personality: A rare and unique profession, essential for commanding armies in battle. An army without a Battle Formation Master is much weaker than the one that has.
cultivation.trivia:
In ancient times, Battle Formation Master was considered as a branch of the Spiritual Array Master. If one has the foundation as a Spiritual Array Master, it will be easier to enter the foothold of it compared to others.

During the ancient war of the Great Thousand World, Battle Formation Masters were the most dazzling ones. They led armies of myriad clans and stood at the forefront of the battle against the Fiend Clans.  That was also the reason that they suffered great losses, even many of Battle Formation inheritances were destroyed. When the ancient war ended, the number of Battle Formation Masters became very few. Nowadays, Battle Formation Masters are even rarer than Spiritual Array Masters.

cultivation.title: Battle Formations
cultivation.introText: Battle Formation is a special method of gathering the strength of an army/troop’s Battle Wills and unleash the extreme boundary of the army power. This method requires the ability to integrate the Battle Wills of the entire army. In other words, Battle Will of each Army’s member must be aligned with the Battle Will of the commander (Battle Formation Master).
cultivation.appearance:
Battle Formation is a special method of gathering the strength of an army/troop’s Battle Wills and unleash the extreme boundary of the army power. This method requires the ability to integrate the Battle Wills of the entire army. In other words, Battle Will of each Army’s member must be aligned with the Battle Will of the commander (Battle Formation Master).

Battle Will is the fusion of Willpower and Spiritual Energy of an individual. Because every single person’s Battle Will is different, it is not an easy task to perfectly integrate the Battle Wills all people. Trying to get ahold of it would require the Will in each person’s Battle Will to follow orders. That’s the basic requirement for a Battle Formation. However, there might be thousands people in a troop, and each people has been tempered with blood and fire, their wills are unyielding in nature. Trying to thoroughly unleash the energy from Battle Wills require both parties to achieve trust and harmony without any reservations.

cultivation.title: Battle Will Genius
cultivation.introText: Battle Will Genius is the preliminary stage of the Battle Formation Master.

cultivation.introText: In The Great Ruler novel, there are three main paths of cultivations:
cultivation.appearance:
In The Great Ruler novel, there are three main paths of cultivations:

Spiritual Energy Cultivation: a foundational discipline practiced by all cultivators, serving as the essential prerequisite for any specialized discipline.

Spiritual Array Mastery: a specialized discipline requiring innate talent. For example, when Mu Chen starts learning this path, Wen Ling gives him a test (condensing and controlling Spiritual Seals) to determine whether he has sufficient aptitude.

Battle Formation Mastery: a specialized discipline that demands considerable innate talent, with prior foundation in Spiritual Array Mastery provides a significant advantage. In ancient times, Battle Formation Mastery was classified as a branch of the Spiritual Array Mastery. As such, those who have already become Spiritual Array Masters find it easier to gain a foothold in this path.

Another Cultivation Path:

Physical Body Cultivation: focuses on enhancing the cultivator’s physique; typically practiced as an important supplementary for Spiritual Energy Cultivation path, providing greater durability and combat capability.

Self-reliant, not depends on external conditions.

Fastest activation speed.

Extremely versatile (combat, defense, trapping/sealing, cultivation aids, teleportation).

Generally greater combat power than Spiritual Energy Cultivators.

Power depends on the quality of the surrounding Spiritual Energy.

Slower activation speed. Can be mitigated with pre-made Spiritual Array Seeds.

Power largely relies on the troop strength.

Slowest activation speed due to Battle Will synchronization. Can be somewhat mitigated by storing troops in spatial storage.

Individual Battle Will enhancement techniques.

Collective Battle Wills synchronization/controlling techniques.

In Chinese fantasy novels, the surrounding/ambient Spiritual Energy is commonly referred to as 天地灵力 (“the Spiritual Energy of heaven and earth”, which simply means "the world’s Spiritual Energy") emphasizing its omnipresent and natural origin.

Battle Will = Fusion of Willpower (soul/mental) + Spiritual Energy (physical).
cultivation.personality:
1st to 4th grade are divided by the strength of spiritual energy. However, from 5th grade onward, the differences become significant due to the mastery of spatial abilities. A 5th grade Sovereign can traverse space. A 6th grade Sovereign can cross space cracks. Spiritual energy becomes solid. A 7th grade Sovereign can initially distort space, creating space cracks. A 8th grade Sovereign can control space at will, such as controlling space cracks to kill enemies. A 9th grade Sovereign’s power can initially reach the level of shattering space. Corresponds to the Dou Di and Ancestor stages.

A cultivator reaches this stage by:

1. Surpass the absolute peak of Late-Phase Saint-Grade Heavenly Sovereign Stage.

2. Accumulate power/strength far beyond the limit of the Heavenly Sovereign Stage.

3. Sense the World’s Will and attempt to summon the Firmament Board.

4. Breaking through the Firmament Board’s impenetrable barrier to inscribe their surname on the Board.

To ascend to this stage, a cultivator must:

5. Accumulate strength beyond the Ruler Stage, as inscribing given name is far more difficult than inscribing surname.

6. Penetrate the barrier on the Firmament Board (with vastly greater resistance) to inscribe their given name, thus completing their full true name (surname + given name).

Upon advancing to this stage, one earns the title of The Great Ruler (大主宰, Dà Zhǔ Zǎi) and gains the authority to wield the power of the world.

Spiritual Energy Fusion

Mu Chen/Cultivation

cultivation.title: Demon Heart State
cultivation.introText: Demon Heart State is an ability to enter into absolute controls of one's mind and body in which any external disturbances will be blocked out.  Every single strand of Spiritual Energy in the body, as well as the power of their physique, can be controlled to the limits. Once the user enters into the Demon Heart State, he/she can become a genuine weapon of war and his/her fighting strength will also gain a sharp increase.

cultivation.title: Earth Sovereign Stage
cultivation.introText: For a cultivator who already at the Peak 9th grade Sovereign, it takes a massive amount of Sovereign Spiritual Liquids to breakthrough to Earth Sovereign Realm. This is due to the fact that it is only possible to ascend when the Sovereign Sea ruptures and becomes one with every cell in one's body, effectively making each part of the body into a Sovereign Sea that contains millions of Sovereign Seas. Mu Chen feels that it went from sole to omnipresent.

cultivation.title: Great Thousand World/Firmament Board
cultivation.introText: The Firmament Board is the manifestation of the World's Will of the Great Thousand World, appearing as a large screen in the sky.
cultivation.appearance:
When a cultivator's strength surpasses the Late-Phase Saint-Grade Heavenly Sovereign Stage, they may begin to sense the World's Will and can attempt to summon its manifestation (the Firmament Board). If they can inscribe their true name upon the Board, they gain the ability to wield the power of the Great Thousand World. In other words, when one’s true name is inscribed on the Firmament Board, it means that the Great Thousand World’s Will acknowledges your existence and power.

The Firmament Board is separated into two parts, the surname and given name. Only by completing the two, can one be considered to have left their full true name behind.

Inscribing one's surname on the Board allows transcendence beyond the Heavenly Sovereign Stage — the Ruler Stage.

Inscribing one's full true name (surname + given name) signifies attainment of The Great Ruler Stage.
cultivation.quotes:
The world as a board… and as long as anyone can leave their name on it, they will receive the acknowledgment of the Great Thousand World and possess the world’s energy.

— Martial Ancestor to everyone, Chapter 1528

cultivation.title: Heavenly Completion Stage
cultivation.introText: Heavenly Completion Stage is the third and final sub-stage of the Three Heavens Stage.

cultivation.title: Heavenly Fusion Stage
cultivation.introText: Heavenly Fusion Stage is the first sub-stage of the Three Heavens Stage.

cultivation.title: Heavenly Sovereign Spiritual Body
cultivation.introText: Heavenly Sovereign Spiritual Body was the symbol of Heavenly Sovereign experts, since their body could be turned into pure Spiritual Energy, bestowing them with extraordinary fighting strength. At the same time, they could also unite with the heavens and earth, and the Spiritual Energy in their bodies was practically inexhaustible.

cultivation.title: Heavenly Sovereign Stage
cultivation.introText: Heavenly Sovereigns, the most esteemed level in the Great Thousand World. Many Earthly Sovereigns will never even breach the Heavenly Sovereign level in their entire lives. It is a extremely hard level to enter. One's spiritual energy destroys mountains and shake seas with the slightest touch, one's body is near immortal, the ripples of space cannot damage one's body. Heavenly Sovereigns are called heavenly due to their immense power that is considered godly in the eyes of many. Heavenly Sovereigns are always very high ranking elders, perhaps even a leader of a giant faction. However, even among the few Heavenly Sovereigns, few can reach the level of the true legend, such as Flame Emperor Xiao Yan and Martial Ancestor Lin Dong.

cultivation.title: Human Body Disaster Stage
cultivation.introText: Human Body Disaster Stage is the first sub-stage of the Three Sovereign Disasters Stage, strengthening the physical body.

cultivation.title: Mu Chen/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: Obtained in the Hidden Scripture Pavilion, after defeated Garuda.
cultivation.personality: Immortal Physique was the prerequisite for being able to fuse and use the Primordial Immortal Body.

cultivation.title: Primordial Immortal Body
cultivation.introText: When Mu Chen obtained ownership of the Primordial Immortal Body, he was not able to utilize its full power until he fused with the body.

cultivation.title: Ruler Stage
cultivation.introText: The Ruler Stage marks a cultivator’s transcendence beyond the Heavenly Sovereign Stage. It is the first stage where a cultivator earns the acknowledgment of the Great Thousand World’s Will and is granted the authority to wield a portion of the World Power.
cultivation.trivia: This stage is initially unnamed, with the official English translation simply uses "Ranker" to refer to those whose name is on the list/board (the Firmament Board). After Mu Chen's breakthrough, he names the realm as the Ruler Stage.

cultivation.title: Sensing Stage
cultivation.introText: Sensing Stage marks the beginning of a cultivator's journey in the Spiritual Energy Cultivation.
cultivation.appearance:
At this stage, cultivators:

Learn to sense the Spiritual Energy/Aura within the world (heaven and earth) and to resonate to it; and

Attempt to absorb the world's Spiritual Energy into their body. However, they remain unable to absorb this energy into their body, and therefore cannot practice Spiritual Arts.

This stage can be regarded as the Preliminary Stage, where one has yet to be recognized as a true cultivator, as they are still unable to absorb the world's Spiritual Energy.

cultivation.title: Sovereign Celestial Body
cultivation.introText: Sovereign Celestial Body is the signature battle form of Sovereign Stage cultivators.
cultivation.history: The specific ranks of these Sovereign Celestial Bodies are unknown.

cultivation.title: Sovereign Sea
cultivation.introText: Upon successfully ascending to the Sovereign Realm, the Aura Sea within a person would be shattered and replaced with the Sovereign Sea. Shattering the Aura Sea and forming the Sovereign Sea.

cultivation.title: Sovereign Stage
cultivation.introText: The Sovereign Stage is the seventh stage of Spiritual Energy Cultivation.
cultivation.trivia:
According to the author, the Sovereign Stage is equivalent to the following stages in his other related novels:(1) (2)

Wu Dong Qian Kun: Ancestor Stage (祖境).

cultivation.introText: Spiritual Energy Disaster Stage the third and final sub-stage of the Three Sovereign Disasters Stage, strengthening the Spiritual Energy.

cultivation.title: Spirit of Battle Will
cultivation.introText: Spirit of Battle Will (战意之灵 Zhàn Yì Zhī Líng) is an insight from comprehending the Battle Will to a higher realm. With the Spirit of Battle Will being refined, the power of Battle Will could be completely unleashed.  In a battle between troops with equal strength, the troop that possesses a Spirit of Battle Will can easily defeat the other troop. However, it is extremely hard to refine the Spirit of Battle Will.
cultivation.appearance:
Spirit of Battle Will (战意之灵 Zhàn Yì Zhī Líng) is an insight from comprehending the Battle Will to a higher realm. With the Spirit of Battle Will being refined, the power of Battle Will could be completely unleashed.  In a battle between troops with equal strength, the troop that possesses a Spirit of Battle Will can easily defeat the other troop. However, it is extremely hard to refine the Spirit of Battle Will.

Spirit of Battle Will is a required foothold of becoming a Battle Formation Master. Only those that have refined the Spirit of Battle Will could be qualified to become a genuine Battle Formation Master.

Mu Chen for the first time used Spirit of Battle Will when he was commanding Nine Nether Troop fighting against a troop from Dragon-Snake Sect during Hunting War.

cultivation.title: Spirit Stage
cultivation.introText: Spirit Stage is the fourth stage of Spiritual Energy Cultivation,
cultivation.appearance:
The benefits of having own Divine Soul are:

The Divine Soul is capable of independently circulating the Spiritual Art. While, at the same time, the cultivator is also circulating the Spiritual Art with his own body. This will result in one’s cultivation would be twice as effective. Thus, the Divine Soul is extremely beneficial to one’s cultivation progress.

Ability to ingest a Beast's soul essence (Beast Spirit) which will then merge with the cultivator's Divine Soul. After merging with the Beast's soul essence, the cultivator will gain a portion of the Beast's ability and physique.

A Spirit Stage powerhouse who ingests a Spiritual Beast’s Soul Essence will possess some of the distinct characteristics and strength that the Spiritual Beast had when it was alive. For example, Mu Feng’s Dragonfire Bird grants Mu Feng its speed, while Zhou Ye’s Mountain Spirit Rhinoceros grants him its pure strength.

After one reaches Spirit Stage, the strongest attacking method is the Spiritual Beast’s Soul Essence that they ingest. Therefore, it is natural that their strength will be stronger if they ingest a stronger Spiritual Beast. However, normally, it should be quite difficult for a Spirit Stage powerhouse to ingest the Soul Essence of a Spiritual Beast that is stronger than them. Only a few lucky individuals could successfully do that, such as Mu Feng who at Spirit Stage but could ingest Dragonfire Bird that possesses strength at Heavenly Fusion Stage.

In order to ingest Beast’s Soul Essence, the cultivator must first wipe out the consciousness of the Beast. They would definitely have to face the resistance from the Beast while they perform this act. Some of the fierce Beasts would even take the opportunity to counterattack and attempt to swallow its owner instead.

An alternative to ingesting beast's soul essences is to form a Bloodline Bond between the Human and the Beast. Using this method will lead to a much more complete usage of the Beast’s capabilities. However, there is negative side of this method, as their lives are linked/tied together. No matter which side suffered a threat to their life, the other party would suffer a backlash from the Bloodline Bond.

As the Spirit Stage cultivators get stronger and advance to higher Stage, the power of the Beast Soul Essence will also slowly fade and will no longer be usable, unless they refine the Soul Essence of a powerful Spiritual Beast back when they were in the Spirit Stage. For example, Wu Ling’s Beast Soul Essence – Divine War Ape can still be powerful and useful even he already at very high cultivation stage (Spirit Disaster Stage).

cultivation.introText: Spiritual Array Master (灵阵师 Líng Zhèn Shī) has the capability to construct Spiritual Arrays. They could form Spiritual Arrays by harnessing the world’s Spiritual Energy.
cultivation.appearance:
Spiritual Array Master (灵阵师 Líng Zhèn Shī) has the capability to construct Spiritual Arrays. They could form Spiritual Arrays by harnessing the world’s Spiritual Energy.

In order to become a Spiritual Array Master, one has to learn first how to create Spiritual Seals. Spiritual Seals are the foundations of arranging a Spiritual Array. Condensing and controlling the Spiritual Seals is a test for beginners. If they are clumsy and slow when condensing and controlling the Spiritual Seals, then that means that they are not sensitive to Spiritual Seals. In other words, it means that they do not have sufficient aptitude to become a Spiritual Array Master.

Aside from Spiritual Seals, a Spiritual Array Master needs another essential item, Array Diagram. Constructing a Spiritual Array is extremely difficult. It is equivalent to a large-scaled construction project. The Spiritual Seals are the cornerstone and the paths of connections. While, the Array Diagram is the design blueprint. Without a complete design, it is impossible to begin the construction.
cultivation.personality: The Spiritual Array Master is a highly regarded profession for their utility in multiple areas. All forces need the help of Spiritual Array Masters for constructing various types of Spiritual Arrays, such as defensive Spiritual Arrays, offensive Spiritual Arrays, Arrays for cultivation purpose.

cultivation.title: Spiritual Energy
cultivation.introText: Spiritual Energy (灵力, Líng Lì) is the world's Spiritual Aura (灵气, Líng Qì) that has been absorbed into the cultivator's body and stored in the Aura Sea (气海, Qì Hǎi).

cultivation.title: Spiritual Energy Disaster Stage
cultivation.introText: Spiritual Energy Disaster Stage the second sub-stage of the Three Sovereign Disasters Stage, strengthening the Spiritual Energy.

cultivation.title: Spiritual Energy Fusion
cultivation.introText: Spiritual Energy Fusion is a method that can only be performed by the ones who have Bloodline Bond. It is actually quite a straightforward method. As long as the Human is able to fuse their Spiritual Energy with the Beast's Spiritual Energy, the Human will be able to obtain a special power within their Spiritual Energy.

cultivation.title: Spiritual Movement Stage
cultivation.introText: Spiritual Movement Stage is the second stage of Spiritual Energy Cultivation.

cultivation.title: Spiritual Pulse
cultivation.introText: Spiritual Pulse (灵脉, lit. Spiritual Veins) is known to bring numerous benefits to cultivators. A cultivator who possesses a Spiritual Pulse would have a much faster training speed. Moreover, activating their Spiritual Pulse will increase the owner's battle prowess.
cultivation.appearance:
At the start of one's cultivation, those with a higher-grade Spiritual Pulse would cultivate faster. However, as one reaches higher cultivation level, the benefits of Spiritual Pulse seemed gradually fades. Many believe that Spiritual Pulse is only useful in the early stages of cultivations and become less significant later on. But the deep-seated Spiritual Pulse within one's body doesn't actually useless; rather, most people lack the strength to truly refine it. To do so, one must meet a necessary condition: becoming a Heavenly Sovereign and cultivating a Heavenly Sovereign Spiritual Body (天尊灵体, lit. Heavenly Venerable Spiritual Body). Only by transforming the physical body into a spiritual body can one sense the deep-seated Spiritual Pulse and subsequently refine it, allowing one's spiritual body to reach a perfect state.

Only by refining the Spiritual Pulse hidden deep within the flesh and completely merging it with the Heavenly Sovereign Spiritual Body can the Heavenly Sovereign Spiritual Body be fully perfected. A perfected Heavenly Sovereign Spiritual Body not only possesses greater mysteries but will also generally develop a Spiritual Pulse Divine Ability. The development of this divine ability is often related to the cultivation method one practices. The level of the Spiritual Pulse divine ability depends on the strength of the one's Spiritual Pulse. It is said that some Spiritual Pulse divine abilities derived from Divine-grade spiritual pulses can be considered among the top-tier divine abilities, perhaps even comparable to the 36 Peerless Divine Abilities.

artifacts.title: Ancestral Pagoda
artifacts.introText: Ancestral Pagoda was the most treasured Saint Artifact of the Ancient Buddha Clan.  All the Clan members refined their Divine Pagoda with the help of the Ancestral Pagoda.

artifacts.introText: The treasure of the Ancient Spirit Clan, a Saint Rank - Peerless Saint Artifact.

artifacts.introText: Angel Spear is a Low Rank Divine Artifact, used Ji Xuan. It is given by the Saint Spiritual Academy due to his outstanding performance and contributions.
artifacts.appearance: A beautiful long spear with an unusual shape. There is a pair of wings unfolding on the body of the spear which looks similar to that of an angel’s wings.

artifacts.title: Army Seal
artifacts.introText: Army Seal is a token used by Battle Formation Masters for controlling and commanding their armies.

artifacts.title: Azure Eagle Sword
artifacts.introText: Azure Eagle Sword is a Middle-Rank Spiritual-Tier Artifact, with the Soul Essence of an Azure Light Eagle is sealed inside it. The Azure Light Eagle has power comparable to a Heavenly Fusion Stage, and is known for its speed. At its fastest speed, even a Heavenly Transformation Stage expert would have a hard time hunting it.

artifacts.title: Black Tortoise Seal
artifacts.introText: The seal is a Quasi Divine Artifact Mu Chen obtains in the Divine Wood Academy during the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament.
artifacts.appearance: A stone seal shrouded in a dark green shadow, adorned with ancient patterns on its surface. A stone tortoise is intricately carved onto the seal.

artifacts.title: Blood Devouring Sea Spear
artifacts.introText: Blood Devouring Sea Spear is an Ominous High Rank Spiritual Artifact owned by Bai Xuan. It is a savage blood-red spear, emitting a frightening and baleful aura.

artifacts.title: Blood Hawk Spear
artifacts.introText: Blood Hawk Spear is a Middle-Rank Divine Artifact. The priced treasure of the Blood Hawk Palace, used by Cao Feng.

artifacts.title: Celestial Spirit Lotus
artifacts.introText: Celestial Spirit Lotus is a worldly treasure which is formed within the Spirit Tide due to the accumulated Spiritual Aura. Every time a Spirit Tide occurs, there would be one single Celestial Spirit Lotus that appears. The Celestial Spirit Lotus itself isn’t much use.. However, its Spirit Lotus Seed possesses miraculous effects of stabilizing Spiritual Energy as well as solidifying one's foundation.

artifacts.title: Crimson Jade Lotus Seat
artifacts.introText: It was a Middle rank Saint Artifact, had healing properties.

artifacts.title: Demon Heart Lightning Lotus
artifacts.introText: Demon Heart Lightning Lotus is an explosive Divine Artifact that can only be used once. It requires the Nether Demon Heart Lightning as material to refine it. If it explodes, it could even make a Fifth Grade Sovereign feels danger.

artifacts.title: Demon Slayer Token
artifacts.introText: A token issued by Great Thousand Palace, which was used for record keeping of the killing of members of the Fiend Clans.  Every time the Token holder killed a member of the Fiend Clans, he/she would be rewarded with Demon Slayer Points, which could be exchanged for treasures in the Great Thousand Palace. Furthermore, as long as one had high enough Demon Slayer Points, one could even exchange them for Peerless Divine Abilities or even Top 20 Sovereign Celestial Bodies.

artifacts.title: Dense Water Spiritual Pearl
artifacts.introText: The Dense Water Spiritual Pearl contains an extremely bizarre form of Spiritual Water called Dense Water. A single liter weighs 1,000 kilograms. It could even crush a mountain. It can be used for both offense and defense.

artifacts.title: Devouring Demonic Dragon Spear
artifacts.introText: Spoils of war from Mo Xingtian, a Peerless-Rank Spiritual Artifact.

artifacts.title: Divine Battle Will Board
artifacts.introText: A chess board containing Battle Formation of one thousand Stone Troops. It is a consumable type, as it can only be used once before it turns into ashes.

artifacts.title: Divine Dragon-Phoenix Fruit
artifacts.introText: The golden fruits looked extremely miraculous, with the appearance of a dragon and phoenix intertwining. As they intertwined, they formed into a wondrous dragon-phoenix fruit. These fruits were only born from a perfect fusion of the True Dragon and Phoenix’s Blood Essences. Found in the skulls of True Dragon and True Phoenix who fell in the Dragon-Phoenix Haven, the point where the dragon and phoenix’s teeth sunk into each other from when they deeply bit one another, they contained the essence of the True Dragon and Phoenix heads.

artifacts.title: Divine Lightning Bead
artifacts.introText: Divine Lightning Bead possesses the aura of divine lightning. It has the ability to strengthen the Spiritual Energy within one’s body as well as their physical body. Price: 200 Spiritual Value Points per bead.

artifacts.title: Divine Pagoda
artifacts.introText: Divine Pagoda is the highest level of pagoda that can be manifested from the Ancient Buddha Clan bloodline. It was a manifestation resulted from cultivating the Great Pagoda Art.
artifacts.trivia: Aside from Mu Chen, among the younger generation of the Ancient Buddha Clan, only Xuan Luo managed to form the Divine Pagoda. But, looking at the Pagoda radiance, Xuan Luo’s was inferior than Mu Chen’s.

artifacts.title: Divine Spiritual Fruit
artifacts.introText: The fruits from the Divine Spiritual Tree, greatly beneficial in tempering of one’s fleshly body and are able to remove all impurities from the body.

artifacts.title: Divine Spiritual Tree
artifacts.introText: Divine Spiritual Tree is an extremely rare heavenly treasure, born from the endless life force of the heavens and the earth.

artifacts.title: Divine Wood Guard
artifacts.introText: Divine Wood Guard is a gigantic greenish wooden statue, appears to be made of weathered wood. It is approximately a hundred meters tall, wearing a dark greenish armor and holding a greenish wooden plaque. Its strength far surpasses any Spiritual Energy Disaster expert.

artifacts.title: Divine Wood Plaque
artifacts.introText: The greenish wood plaque functioning as key for entering the Divine Wood Academy during the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament. It required six plaques to be functioned as key.

artifacts.title: Draconic Spirit Bracelets
artifacts.introText: Draconic Spirit Bracelets is a High-Rank Spiritual-Tier Artifact, dark red in color and shaped like a scarlet dragon with its head and tail linked to form a seamless circle. A powerful Spiritual Energy ripples from it and one could hear the faint roars of a dragon.

artifacts.title: Dragon Ascension Gate
artifacts.introText: Dragon Ascension Gate was located on the passage to the Ancient Haven Palace. There were a total of three Gates. This Dragon Ascension Gate was a Saint Artifact, and was the threshold of the Ancient Haven Palace for qualification to enter the Palace.

artifacts.title: Dragon-Phoenix Golden Armor
artifacts.introText: Dragon-Phoenix Golden Armor is a dark-golden armor that seemed to be made of golden scales, looking extremely ferocious. On the scales, a draconic image could be vaguely seen, emanating a terrifying pressure. There is a huge pair of phoenix wings behind the armor slowly unfolding.  This Dragon-Phoenix Golden Armor possessed the powerful defense of a True Dragon’s scales and speed of a True Phoenix. The ability of this armor was something that not even a Middle-Rank Divine Artifact could match up with.

artifacts.title: Emperor Inheritance Pool
artifacts.introText: The Emperor Inheritance Pool is actually Immortal Physique of the Immortal Emperor which contains boundless Spiritual Energy.

artifacts.title: Fallen Origin Aura
artifacts.introText: Fallen Origin Aura is a bizarre energy formed from the fusion of the Sovereign Sea of the fallen experts and the special energy in the Fallen Battlefield.

artifacts.title: Fallen Origin Pellets
artifacts.introText: The experts that fell in the Fallen Battlefield will have their Sovereign Seas turned into Fallen Origin Pellets through time. The Fallen Origin Pellets are extremely beneficial to cultivation. Furthermore, they are also absolutely needed to break the Earth Sovereign experts’ Treasuries.

artifacts.title: Fire Celestial Lotus
artifacts.introText: Fire Celestial Lotus is an evolved form of the Fire Spirit Lotus. If there were many Fire Spirit Lotuses growing in the same place, there was a high probability that one of the Fire Celestial Lotuses succeeded in its evolution and became Fire Celestial Lotus.

artifacts.title: Fire Spirit Lotus
artifacts.introText: A fiery-red lotus is blooming on the surface of magma. The center of the flower blazed with flames and within those flames there are thumb-size fire lotuses.

artifacts.title: Forging God Crystal
artifacts.introText: The Forging God Crystal is a necessary material that is required when forging Divine Weapons. It's considered so extremely rare that even sovereigns would go crazy for them. Luo Li managed to acquire one during the Hunting War of the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy. Where she got one in an auction, with Mu Chen facing off against Mu Fengyang. Upon acquiring it, Luo Li said that she would use it to remove one of the seals on her Divine Sword, the Luo Shen Sword.

artifacts.title: Four Saint Pagoda
artifacts.introText: Four Saint Pagoda was a black and white pagoda located in the Primordial Sacred Abyss. It had only four layers, each layer sealed-off a Sky Monarch’s remnant soul with a Saint Heavenly Sovereign (Ancestor)’s remnant soul guarding it.

artifacts.title: God-Binding Whip
artifacts.introText: It was forged from the branch of a Primordial Mandala Flower at Heavenly Sovereign level.
artifacts.appearance: The whip is covered in spikes while emanating dark and cold flickers. Every single section of the whip is engraved with ancient runes that give out a peculiar feeling when it moves.

artifacts.title: Golden Feather Sword
artifacts.introText: A golden long sword which was extremely bizarre. The edge of the sword was filled with densely packed sawtooth blades. There was a golden light circulating at the edge of the sword with an extremely sharp aura emitting from it.

artifacts.title: Great Meru Demonic Pillar
artifacts.introText: The Great Meru Demonic Pillar is a Primordial Ominous Artifact, its rank is unknown.
artifacts.appearance: A black stone pillar which appears extremely ancient with its surface carved with strange patterns. The pillar towers to about a hundred zhang (~330 meters).
artifacts.history: This artifact had passed through the hands of many experts since the ancient times. Eventually it landed on the hands of the Demonic Dragon Palace, but White Dragon Sovereign took it away when he left. Later, it was obtained by Mu Chen during the White Dragon Sovereign's Treasury mission.

artifacts.title: Great Meru Saint Pillar
artifacts.introText: Great Meru Saint Pillar is an offensive-type artifact, forged by Mu Chen when he is in the midst of fighting with Heavenly Evil Monarch in the final battle. Its power far surpasses the level of "Peerless Saint Artifact", thereby it is best described as a "Beyond Peerless Saint Artifact".
artifacts.appearance: This weapon resembles the imposing appearance of the Great Meru Demonic Pillar, but can be shrunk down to the size of a staff.

artifacts.title: Heavenly Emperor Sword
artifacts.introText: Heavenly Emperor Sword is a longsword looked like a normal crystal sword, but was in fact what kept the 2 bodies of the Nine-Corpse Sky Monarch sealed after the Heavenly Emperor had managed to kill 7 of them. According to Mandala, it can only be wielded by someone who has cultivated the Immortal Golden Body or have a cultivation of the Saint Heavenly Sovereign Realm.  With it Mu Chen can freely enter nearly all of the Ancient Haven Palace except for the Hidden Scripture Pavilion.

artifacts.title: Heavenly Sovereign Blood Essence
artifacts.introText: Heavenly Sovereign Blood essence is the blood essence of a Heavenly Sovereign expert who passed away in the Divine Spiritual Mountain.

artifacts.title: Heavenly Spirit Jade Essence
artifacts.introText: The Heavenly Spirit Jade Essence is an earring that's formed after the natural Spiritual Energy has been compressed for countless years.
artifacts.appearance: An exquisite earring that seemed to be forged from crystals, with an emerald liquid hanging on it, which emanated an extremely pure aura.

artifacts.title: Holy Spirit Pellet
artifacts.introText: Holy Spirit Pellet is one of the creation of the Spirit-Pellet Butterfly Fairy. This Pellet could allow a Quasi Perfect Earth Sovereign to step into the Perfect Earth Sovereign.

artifacts.title: Immortal Catalog
artifacts.introText: It is revealed by the Mysterious Black Paper residing inside Mu Chen's Aura Sea that the Immortal Catalog is a Divine Law of the Ancient Antiquity. The mysterious black paper is one part of the Immortal Catalog, and there should be a total of four similar pages. The other three pages also contain cultivation methods for Sovereign Celestial Bodies that are similar to the Great Solar Undying Body.
artifacts.appearance:
It is revealed by the Mysterious Black Paper residing inside Mu Chen's Aura Sea that the Immortal Catalog is a Divine Law of the Ancient Antiquity. The mysterious black paper is one part of the Immortal Catalog, and there should be a total of four similar pages. The other three pages also contain cultivation methods for Sovereign Celestial Bodies that are similar to the Great Solar Undying Body.

The Mysterious Black Paper inside Mu Chen's Aura Sea is named the “Sealing Volume”, possesses the power of sealing.  It is able to suppress and seals Nine Nether and Great Meru Demonic Pillar within his body.   Later, Mandala tells Mu Chen that the Mysterious Black Paper has a set of divine runes of the Primordial Mandala Flower. It is a mysterious flower that possesses the ability to seal anything.   Thus, the Mysterious Black Paper could also be categorized as an Artifact for its sealing capability.

artifacts.title: Immortal Origin
artifacts.introText: It was immortal aura of the Immortal Golden Body. Each person who had cultivated the Immortal Golden Body had this aura, as it was the foundation of the Immortal Golden Body.  If somebody absorbed it, it would strengthen his/her own Immortal Golden Body. On the other hand, the person who lost this aura would be severely weakened.

artifacts.title: Life-Extinguishing Pupil
artifacts.introText: It has the appearance of palm-sized black eyeball, made with the eyeball of the Primordial Treasure Beast as the base material, with some powerful treasures added inside. It could be considered the lifeline treasure of the Treasure Beast. If it wasn’t for the Primordial Treasure Beast dying prematurely, the Primordial Treasure Beast would have definitely refined it into a genuine Saint Artifact. But even so, the Life-Extinguishing Pupil was the strongest Quasi-Saint Artifact that the Primordial Treasure Beast had refined.

artifacts.title: Lightning Essence
artifacts.introText: Lightning Essence is formed after lightning was refined to a certain degree.

artifacts.title: Lightning God Pill
artifacts.trivia: At the same time as getting the Lightning God Pill, Mu Chen also got the Lightning God’s Lotus

artifacts.title: Lightning God’s Lotus
artifacts.introText: Lightning God’s Lotus is an extremely rare Heavenly Treasure. Similar to the Lightning God’s Pill, there’s only an extremely small chance that it would be born within the lightning energies. It was born in the lightning energies of the ninth level of the Lightning Territory in the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy as a byproduct of the Northern Sea Dragon trying to create a Lightning God's Pill. Northern Dragon gave it to Mu Chen to aid with his cultivation of the Lightning God Physique.

artifacts.title: Lightning-Devouring Beast’s Heart
artifacts.introText: In ancient times, there was a beast that didn’t consume vegetation nor meat for food. Instead, it consumed lightnings as its food and the lightnings had gathered in its heart, was suppressed within and possessed a destructive power. The Lightning Devouring Beast’s Heart is classified by its colors. The Lightning Devouring Beast’s Heart is classified by its colors. Beyond ten thousand years old, it would be pure gold in color.  Thousands of years old had silver color.  It contains terrifying lightning energies. Although it cannot kill an Earth Sovereign, it’s deadly to anyone beneath the cultivation of Earth Sovereign Realm. This item could only be used once.

artifacts.title: Luo Shen Sword
artifacts.introText: The Luo Shen Sword carried by Luo Li is the most valuable Divine Artifact of the Luo God Clan.
artifacts.appearance:
A black longsword covered in mysterious runes.

The sword was azure in colour as it seemed to be forged from ice, it was translucent, and through the sword blade, there was a section that seemed like ice bone. That ice bone was filled with ferocious spikes, and the spikes seem to be extended to the edge of the sword.
artifacts.history:
Luo Li received it from her grandfather, Luo Tianshen, who had set up three seals on it since she wasn't able to control it at the time due to her strength.

After being unable to open a single seal in the past few years, Luo Li used the Divine Forging Stone to open its first seal during the Academy's Hunting War.

During her battle against Xue Tianhe in the Great Spiritual Academy Tournament, Luo Li unleashed the true form of the Luo Shen Sword for the first time.

artifacts.title: Mirror of Judgement
artifacts.introText: Mirror of Judgement is a High-Rank Divine Artifact jointly owned by the Five Great Academies.
artifacts.appearance: A bronze mirror, roughly a few thousand meters. The rim of the bronze mirror is filled with extremely profound runes, ancient and obscure. The surface of the mirror is dark ash-grey as if it is covered in dust and could not be seen through.

artifacts.title: Mountain River’s Ruler Seal
artifacts.introText: Mountain River’s Ruler Seal is a Middle-Rank Saint Artifact which targets the Sovereign Celestial Body. It has the capability to seal-off the opponent Sovereign Celestial Body.
artifacts.appearance: A black jade seal with mountains and rivers engraved on it.

artifacts.title: Mustard Seed Bracelet
artifacts.introText: A Mustard Seed Bracelet is a special Artifact,  This item has the power of constructing space and is an extremely valuable storage device. It allows the owner to store large items rather than carry them.

artifacts.title: Myriad Beast Needle
artifacts.introText: Myriad Beast Needle, a consumable-type High Rank Divine Artifact. Refined with the blood essence of myriad beasts, it was extremely ferocious and required the blood essence of the user to use it. The stronger the blood essence, the more powerful it would be.

artifacts.title: Nether Demon Heart Lightning
artifacts.introText: Nether Demon Heart Lightning is a special lightning energy comparable to the Undying Flames. Nether Demon Heart Lightning is one of the more bizarre lightning in the world. Not only is it violent like the other lightning energies, but the offensive ability of it is also the sound of thunder, the Lightning Burst. The Nether Demon Heart Lightning can disregard a majority of the defenses. It is born from the heart, so it will directly appear in a person’s heart, it has no shape and form. The Lightning Burst will cause a disorder to a person’s thoughts, allowing the heart demon to rise. It is so much so that the person will not be able to control their own Spiritual Energy, or even suffer the backlash from their own Spiritual Energy and die.

artifacts.title: Nine Cauldrons Divine Armor
artifacts.introText: Nine Cauldrons Divine Armor is a Peerless Spiritual Artifact. Can defend against an all-out attack from a Heavenly Transformation Stage. Price: 3,300,000 Spiritual Value Points

artifacts.title: Nine Revolution Azure Lotus
artifacts.introText: The Nine Revolution Azure Lotus was a rare treasure of the heavens and earth, born by absorbing the lifeforce in the world, making it extremely profound. Mu Chen obtained it in the outer region of the God's Cemetery.

artifacts.title: Northsea Tortoise
artifacts.introText: Northsea Tortoise is a Spirit-Grade Peerless Divine Artifact owned by Qin Beixuan.

artifacts.title: Obsidian Spirit Shield
artifacts.introText: Spirit Stone Stove is a Low-Rank Spiritual-Tier protective Artifact. After defeating Zhou Li, Mu Chen seizes it from him as the spoils of battle and gives it to Ye Sun'er.

artifacts.title: Ocean-Whelming Seal
artifacts.introText: A black stone seal, a Low rank Saint Artifact. It could be used to escape by crushing it.

artifacts.title: Peak Blood Essence
artifacts.introText: Peak Blood Essence is the condensation of blood essences of flying beast’s ancestors who fused their bodies into the Deification Pool.

artifacts.title: Phoenix Bell
artifacts.introText: Phoenix Bell was a Peerless rank Divine Artifact with defense and hiding capabilities. With this item, one could hide one's aura from the investigation of the other experts.

artifacts.title: Planetary Fetus
artifacts.introText: Planetary Fetus could be considered as a Plane’s Spirit. It’s the essence of the entire Plane, but it didn’t have any consciousness. So, if one could gain control of it, then he/she would be able to utilize the Plane’s power.  If one could refine the Planetary Fetus, then he/she would be equivalent to the ruler of the Plane and determined all the lifeform' lives and deaths with just a thought.  Furthermore, when fighting, one only needed to link his Will with the Plane and extracted endless Spiritual Energy from the Plane.

artifacts.title: Primordial Immortal Pagoda
artifacts.introText: Primordial Immortal Pagoda is an ancient stone pagoda created by the Immortal Emperor. The Primordial Immortal Body is kept inside this Pagoda. The Primordial Immortal Assembly is held inside the Pagoda.

artifacts.title: Promotion Pellet
artifacts.introText: Pill that could raise one’s Divine Ability to the next level. It even works for Peerless Divine Abilities. The Promotion Pellet was the signature product of the Spirit-Pellet Butterfly Fairy.

artifacts.title: Punishment Spiritual Combat Doll
artifacts.introText: Punishment Spiritual Combat Doll is a specialized combat puppet created by the Punishment Hall of the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy. Only eighteen exist within the entire hall, each possessing strength comparable to the Late Phase Heavenly Completion Stage.
artifacts.personality: These puppets possess resilient bodies and feel no pain. In combat, even experts at the Late Phase Heavenly Completion Stage find themselves hard-pressed when facing the puppets.

artifacts.title: Python’s Fury
artifacts.introText: Python’s Fury, a Middle-Rank Spiritual-Tier Artifact, is a spear forged by using the horn of Golden-Horn Spirit Python. If it is used in battles, the spear tip will be like an angry python. It possesses exceptional power.

artifacts.title: Scarlet Dragon Armor
artifacts.introText: A crimson armor that was engraved with runes of roaring dragons, looking both sinister and ferocious. It was a set with the Scarlet Dragon Spear, since they had the same aura.

artifacts.title: Scarlet Dragon Spear
artifacts.introText: Scarlet Dragon Spear is an offensive type Quasi-Saint Rank Artifact.

artifacts.title: Sea-Shattering Pearl
artifacts.introText: Sea-Shattering Pearl is an offensive type Quasi-Saint Rank Artifact.

artifacts.title: Sovereign Elixir
artifacts.introText: Sovereign Elixir is extremely rare, since it was reported that only Sovereign Spiritual Liquid that had been refined to the limits could be formed into elixir, having a price tag comparable to a Low Rank Divine Artifact.

artifacts.title: Sovereign Spiritual Liquid
artifacts.introText: The Sovereign Spiritual Liquid is something that only Sovereign realm experts could refine. The Spiritual Energy contained in it is not only pure, but also possesses spirituality. Naturally, that spirituality depended on the refiner’s strength. Therefore, Sovereign Spiritual Liquid of higher grades possess the ability to take form.

artifacts.title: Spatial Ship
artifacts.introText: A Low Rank Divine Artifact without any offensive capabilities. Under the maximum speed, it is hard for even a Sixth Grade Sovereign to chase after it.

artifacts.title: Spirit Bug Flute
artifacts.introText: Spirit Bug Flute is a black flute, a couple inches long with various insect patterns engraved on it. Members of the Bug Spirit Clan use Spirit Bug Flutes to control Spirit Bugs that they nurture.

artifacts.title: Spirit Convergence Pillar
artifacts.introText: Spirit Convergence Pillar is the main part of Spirit Convergence Array. Many Spirit Convergence Pillars will form a Spirit Convergence Array. The effect of a place near the Spirit Convergence Pillar is definitely better for cultivation than anywhere else.

artifacts.title: Spirit Convergence Rock
artifacts.introText: Spirit Convergence Rock is a cultivation-enhancing material used to craft the Spirit Convergence Pillar. However, its price is quite high, so not everyone can afford it.

artifacts.title: Spirit Destruction Bead
artifacts.introText: Spirit Destruction Bead is an extremely destructive Spiritual-Tier Artifact.
artifacts.appearance: A longan-size fiery red bead. Its surface is filled with obscure patterns. Within it, a violent Spiritual Energy seems to flow like a tidal stream.

artifacts.title: Spirit Lotus Seed
artifacts.introText: Within the Spirit Tide, a worldly treasure known as the “Celestial Spirit Lotus” would be formed due to the accumulated Spiritual Aura. Spirit Lotus Seeds on the Celestial Spirit Lotus are considered a rare worldly treasure. It possesses the miraculous effects of stabilizing Spiritual Energy as well as solidifying one's foundation.

artifacts.title: Spirit of the Heavenly Lake
artifacts.introText: It had the appearance of a transparent crystal. It was born from heavens and earth in the Heavenly Lake, and has offensive abilities with strength comparable to Perfect 9th Sovereign. It contained pure power and also the source of power for the Heavenly Lake baptism.

artifacts.title: Spirit Pill
artifacts.introText: Spirit Pill is a Pill that is beneficial to individuals at the Spirit Stage. It can help them advance to the next level. However, the medical energy within the Pill is extremely violent. If it isn’t completely ingested, it would harm the Spiritual Energy within one’s body.

artifacts.title: Spirit Stone Stove
artifacts.introText: Spirit Stone Stove is a Low-Rank Spiritual-Tier protective Artifact. After defeating Zhou Li, Mu Chen seizes it from him as the spoils of battle.

artifacts.title: Spirit Tide
artifacts.introText: In highly ranked Spirit Convergence Arrays, extremely dense Spiritual Aura of the world would be accumulated over the years and then would form what is known as the Spirit Tide.
artifacts.appearance:
In highly ranked Spirit Convergence Arrays, extremely dense Spiritual Aura of the world would be accumulated over the years and then would form what is known as the Spirit Tide.

The Spirit Tide is quite violent and it would be dangerous if one is sucked in. However, within the Spirit Tide, a worldly treasure known as the Celestial Spirit Lotus would be formed due to the accumulated Spiritual Aura. The Spirit Lotus Seeds on the Celestial Spirit Lotus possess miraculous effects of stabilizing Spiritual Energy as well as solidifying one's foundation.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Array Seed
artifacts.introText: Spiritual Array Seed is a Spiritual Array carved onto a small metal sphere. In combat, the user need only throw the seed, which will instantly form the Spiritual Array. Only Spiritual Array Masters of extraordinary abilities can carve such complex and formidable arrays onto so small a surface.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Blood Paste
artifacts.introText: In ancient times, the powerhouses of the Divine Beast Origin sensed the plan of the Fiend Clans and before the destruction arrived, they had self-destructed their own physical bodies in an attempt to obstruct the Fiend Clans. It contains a trace of the blood and flesh essence of those powerhouses.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Blood Paste Embryo
artifacts.introText: Spiritual Blood Paste Embryo looked like an embryo, but the embryo was extremely bizarre. It seemed to have the appearance of numerous Spiritual Beasts at the same time. The blood aura in it was very powerful, that’s why it possessed spirituality. But it’s impossible for a consciousness to be born in this item. Otherwise, it would be able to take form into a genuine Spiritual Beast after myriads of years.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Compass
artifacts.introText: Item that originally belonged to the Fourth Hall Master of the Ancient Haven Palace. It has the ability to search for Fallen Origin Aura in the battlefield of the Hunting War.  It was comparable to a Divine Artifact.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Condensing Bowl
artifacts.introText: There was a special race known as the Spiritual Condensing Race as they possessed a special ability. The Spiritual Artifact that they created would possess the effect of condensing Spiritual Energy. Their pinnacle masterpiece was the Spiritual Condensing Bowl. Activating the bowl could shadow the vast heavens and earth. Any form of Spiritual Energy would be sucked into it and would automatically turn into Sovereign Spiritual Liquids.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Divine Liquid
artifacts.introText: When an Earth Sovereign powerhouse dies, his Sovereign Sea would erode with the passing of time. And when the Sovereign Sea erodes to the limits, it would form the Spiritual Divine Liquid, the final essences of an Earth Sovereign Realm powerhouse. Those Spiritual Divine Liquids are extremely beneficial to Earth Sovereign Realm experts.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Fire Marrow
artifacts.introText: Spiritual Fire Marrow is a condensed and pure flame-attribute Spiritual Energy, extracted from Spiritual Fire Python and other inhabitants of the Greatlaw Blaze Pond.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Frost Puppet
artifacts.introText: Spiritual Frost Puppet is powerful puppet with strength comparable to Perfected Ninth Grade Sovereign Stage. It is gifted by Ying Huanhuan to Lin Jing.
artifacts.appearance: A palm-sized black puppet which can be expanded to human size, wielding a longspear. It is covered in ancient runes, as those runes flicker, a terrifying surge of cold aura freezing the atmosphere.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Light
artifacts.introText: Spiritual Light is also called as Spiritual Crystal, as its appearance looks like a sparkling and transparent gem. Within the gem, boundless pure Spiritual Energy continuously radiated from it.  It is condensed from the extremely pure Spiritual Energy within Spiritual Light Realm. Using this for one's empowerment is truly miraculous.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Value Card
artifacts.introText: Spiritual Value Card is a sparkling crystal card that can store and show Spiritual Value Points of each student of Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy.

artifacts.title: Starlight Demon Suppression Pyramid
artifacts.introText: Starlight Demon Suppression PyramidA is a Low-Rank Saint Artifact, used for suppression and defending, with the appearance of a dark-golden pyramid.

artifacts.title: Stone Guardian
artifacts.introText: Stone Guardian is a special type artifact, and could be controlled through the silver medal which Mu Chen obtains inside the magma where he encounters the Fire Celestial Lotus. However, most of the Stone Guardians could not be controlled by Mu Chen. But, at least the silver medal could interfere with the Stone Guardian’s senses, so they could not see Mu Chen.

artifacts.title: Vajra Spirit Breaking Liquid
artifacts.introText: It is a unique treasure from heavens and earth, transformed from the Vajra Spirit Breaking Rock.

artifacts.title: Void Great Solar Fruit
artifacts.introText: Born in the void, it absorbed the strength of the sun present in the universe. A mature Void Great Sun Fruit would appear akin to a scorching sun within the region it was in. Even after burning for a thousand years, its brilliance would never dim. As long as one refined it, one would have a chance to cultivate a “Great Solar Body” which was ranked 95th in the rankings of the top 99 Sovereign Celestial Bodies.

artifacts.title: Void Spiritual Elixir
artifacts.introText: Void Spiritual Elixir is an elixir for aiding the Battle Formation Master to control the Battle Wills of a troop.
artifacts.appearance: It has a light-red color, layers of spiritual light being endlessly emitted from it. A bizarre ripple also fluctuated from it.

artifacts.title: White Dragon Jade Dowel
artifacts.introText: White Dragon Jade Dowel is an unknown rank Artifact. It was discovered in the depths of White Dragon Hillock. It was most probably left behind by the White Dragon Sovereign who died several hundred years ago in the White Dragon Hillock.

artifacts.title: White Dragon Spiritual Pearl
artifacts.introText: White Dragon Spiritual Pearl contains abundant and extremely pure Spiritual Energy. It could greatly help in cultivation.

artifacts.title: Wind God's Fan
artifacts.introText: A Low rank Saint Artifact of the Wind Mansion Lord was made with a core that contained a Strand of the Profound Yellow Gale. It is an azure color made of feathers of unknown origin. Mu Chen obtained it during Ancient Haven Palace Exploration.

artifacts.title: Wind Resistance Spiritual Pearl
artifacts.introText: Although it’s a High-grade Spiritual Artifact, its offensive attributes aren’t especially strong. However, it has an extremely strong effect against wind attacks.
